title: She Is Wildfire
description: In a land far, far away, this ancient fairytale also wanders. Thorns are walls, mist is a window, and the forest is as mute as a prisoner. Two hunters feast upon the sun and the moon. Until the moonlight shatters, they hunt, and hunt, until death.

title: Crimson Feather
description: Weighed down by exhaustion, she moves forward, crossing an invisible valley. At last, a bird looks up at the solitary moon, drawn to its flaw, mirroring her own. The Seer, with a compassionate gaze, holds this fleeting moment in memory before it slips away forever.

title: Florabound Promise
description: Legend tells of a ring of vines and flowers hidden deep within the midnight forest, marking the path to the fairy's dwelling. Those with shimmering convictions may catch a glimpse of the fairy dancing within the ring and receive her gift. But once that gift is bestowed, where will those radiant convictions ultimately lead?

title: Dawning Heartlight
description: "Even if I never became the person I dreamed of as a child, she still shines, warm and radiant... enough to light up my weary soul."

title: Hymn to Dusk
description: In Itzaland, there was but one race that did not pray to the gods. With wills of iron and fire, they forged a path toward tomorrow. In time, that will endured beyond death and followed their souls into reincarnation, marking the beginning of the intertwined fate between the God of Reincarnation and the Titans.

title: White Night's Ballet
description: Chandeliers poured down golden light, illuminating her first tribute. Amid the crowd's astonishment, she raised her arms and spun, her black dress cleaving the Golden Age's most radiant long night. She was the most perfect miracle before the Titan King's throne, and the proudest invention of the age.

title: Rippling Reverie
description: This land filled with miracles is a song gifted by the world itself, where every note is a dreamlike first encounter, and each turn stirs endless ripples within the heart. Set forth once more, and sing your part, whether it's gentle or lively, resplendent or hushed.

title: Floral Rebirth
description: When do the flowers bloom? Amidst the God of Reincarnation's countless falls and rebirths, as the dragons take up the mantle of Their authority and repeat the long cycles of vigil. Through it all, the blossoms continue to whisper the chronicles of the past—stories of inheritance, the tides of reincarnation, and vows that never wither.

title: Guide of No Return
description: Where twilight meets the dawn, the God of Reincarnation descends upon the mountain peak. They are the final witness, brushing the frost of the world from souls as they depart. They are the guide at the journey's end, ferrying faded stars toward the river of rebirth.

title: Dreamtime Bestowed
description: Far beyond the rainbow's end lay a distant realm, where people once lived in a world of muted gray. Then she arrived, radiant as a rainbow itself, bringing beauty and color back to the world. As little Roucoco opened her fairy-tale book, the path of dreams slowly unfolded with the girl's journey.

title: Chroma's Mortal Heart
description: Mountain mist brushed lightly against jade-born form; morning dew seeped into nascent spirit. From clear stream and forest haze, jade took shape, and true essence stirred. Gentle luster spread across verdant peaks, soft radiance drifting among clouds. The breath of mountains and rivers enfolded Her like wind in an embrace, half awake, half dreaming, aware yet unknowing.

title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life
description: Fate gave rise to the Chromafaces, unbound by any fixed nature. It was the mortal world that tempered their forms and revealed their true selves. Fortunate were they to receive Lady Chroma's instruction, worldly knowledge passed down in turn. Thus, they came to learn that the crafts of a hundred trades could steady restless spirits, and the warmth of mortal life could soothe wandering hearts.

title: Forest Ripple
description: Where does the dew fall? Which tree must be struck for its fruit to drop? How does one endure the long night alone? So many mysteries remain, yet Papa whispers only in the rustle of the wind.

title: Behind Prayers
description: Donning robes and a crown, she was the divine maiden chosen by her people, embodying their hope to bring back their god. The stone altar was cold, the stars hung low, and no one heard the ceaseless prayers from the tower above. From then on, her own name was lost to the world.

title: Born Flawless
description: The daughter, born flawless, grew to see herself in scattered shards. Yet her scars were no ugly flaws, but jewels—each cut shaping her into something more radiant.

title: Providence Immemorial
description: At the meeting of day and night, the God of Reincarnation awakens—embodying both the end and the beginning. With each breath, life and death, growth and decay flow in endless rhythm.

title: Radiant Crown
description: When enveloped in darkness, her heart burns bright like a torch. The old sun has set, but she will bring new light.

title: Echoed Dreams
description: The curtains in the box rose layer by layer, and a familiar melody flowed like a stream. That long-faded dream, that figure enchanted by song, at last, was reunited with old companions.

title: Clouded Loong
description: Cloud ink shaped the Loong's roar, a name bestowed with strokes. Brief strokes, the gentlest pact in the world. No matter how vast the skies, calling its name would reveal the shimmer within its scales beneath the moonlight.

title: Forever Bond
description: Through a crack in the dream, she glimpsed the past, dusk covering the long street. Old memories echoed within, the land broken into shards of longing. Fate slipped through her fingers as she reached out in vain for a past that faded like smoke.

title: Tide of Tears
description: A faint gentle glow and a cold silent current create an eternal scene in the ancient water abyss. A girl who slipped and fell into its depths unknowingly shattered the long-lasting solitude.

title: Enchanted Encounter
description: In a distant land of dreams, the little fairy apprentice, who had long toiled for the wishes of others, finally welcomed a miracle of her own. The dear friend who brought it crossed the Celestial River between reality and fantasy, standing watch over the secret they shared.

title: Crimson Rhapsody
description: She had long been documenting every detail of the story behind the Esseling, transforming it into a precious treasure. She witnessed how the owner once cherished the doll, and now, she saw how the doll's yearning for love had slowly blossomed into a fiery red.

title: Timeless Melody
description: With each twist of the bronze-colored clockwork, the dust-laden pages of ancient poems flutter open once more, and frozen dance steps spring to life. Faewish Sprites begin to dance again, accompanied by the timeless symphony, laced with the creaking melody of time.

title: Dance Till Dawn
description: Friends, come along and embrace the joy! Watch as it awakens the earth, heralds the dawn, scatters happiness, nurtures hope, and when time signals, the fireworks will bloom once more.

title: Stardust Flare
description: The deep night swallowed the path ahead, watching her steps into the dark. Lights glimmered in the distance, and within the lost girl's heart, the first spark of fireworks ignited. From that moment, she found a new home, alongside her old one.

title: Nameless, Selfless
description: She listened closely to the faint murmur of moonlight, which told her that scattered memories wandered through the empty courtyard. Amidst the endless chants, she gathered one name after another, each belonging to herself.

title: Rainfall & Blossoms
description: Rain soaked every brick, and the wind filled every memory. From birth, children took their first steps in the ripples, wandering through the rain. The world gave them the weight of moisture, and they returned it in verses of life.

title: Wings of Wishes
description: Paper wings slowly unfurl, as an unknown voice rises to the skies. A paper crane drifts in the wind, carrying every whispered wish.

title: Blooming Dreams
description: As soon as "Flower Sprite Fairy Tale" hit the shelves, it topped the children's book charts. Many wondered how the once-unknown author could have crafted such a masterpiece after a year-long silence. The author replied, "For me, this story holds much more than just a fairy tale."

title: Crystal Poems
description: The Daughter of Ice is a narrative poetry collection compiled by an unknown traveler, who journeyed far and wide across the globe. The enigmatic, pure girl in the poems—is she a fleeting glimpse from his journey, or a timeless fairy tale whispered through the ages? Whenever asked, the traveler would only smile, leaving the question unanswered.

title: Slumber by Blossoms
description: They are the glimmers born from the god's fingertips. In light's embrace, the lingering pain and obsessions of souls fade away. Listen, that is the song guiding the souls home.

title: Blossoming Stars
description: How long does it take to go from nobody to somebody? If a small star is not bright enough to illuminate the night sky, what about gathering thousands of them and weaving them into a splendid Milky Way?

title: Fairytale Swan
description: A swan brings the most beautiful flowers to the lakeside, and drops her softest feathers. With dreams blessed by the gods, she steps towards a beautiful and bewildering invitation.

title: Flutter Storm
description: That wandering island will never be found again. Perhaps the goddess there still relishes warm moments within the vast expanse of eternity. In that realm, a butterfly flutters, striving to reach the distant human world, stirring a hurricane in someone's heart.

title: Whispers of Waves
description: In a small cottage by the seaside, the sound of waves crashing against the rocks echoes endlessly. The old sailor in the house speaks slowly, claiming he's but a messenger for the sea, narrating the cherished tales of this coastline.

title: Silvergale's Aria
description: The Silvergale, lingering above the wilderness, once brushed against every inch of burgeoning aspirations. Ultimately, He decided to settle, nurturing a sincere heart with moonlight and His melodious song, until desires wilted, and love faded away.

title: Wishful Aurosa
description: Once, a race was awakened by a wish. Now, the miracles of wishes continue, illuminating lives just as the dormant sprites awaken amid the bloom of the Aurosa.

title: Sea of Stars
description: Her dress rippled with the vastness of the celestial river, her dance steps tracing the endless paths of stars. Time and space wove together in a dance of "fate," waiting for the dawn to come again.

title: Mechanical Demonstration
description: Order and commands hang high from the dome, while precise gears drive each chess piece forward and back, leaving trails on the board that calculate all things. It deduces the fate of all things, unaware that it too is a piece in the game.

title: Curtains & Stars
description: She stood on tiptoes, trying to perform her dazzling role. Whether nervous or afraid, blocked or forgetting her lines, she told herself not to fear. Whenever the Little Bear Fairy blinked, her timid lines would turn into shining stars.

title: Blooming Brocade
description: Every morning, as sunlight streamed through the windowpane, the girl placed a freshly bloomed flower in a crystal-clear vase, quietly setting it on the windowsill.

title: Graceful Elegance
description: The curious young princess enters the unfamiliar etiquette hall, her wide eyes sparkling with wonder and anticipation.

title: Heartlake Ripples
description: The rippling waves on the lake surface symbolize the thoughts of the young girl. Amidst the daylight and cloud shadows, all her thoughts spill into the vast expanse of the azure waves, only to be entirely carried away by the flowing waters.

title: Dream in Glimpses
description: Long ago, the figure standing by the window told her, "Design is like solving a puzzle—start from the edges: tailoring, silhouette, fabric, colors... and work your way to the core, your self-expression."

title: Radiant Night
description: The moonlight's soft glow pours over the crystal steps like silver thread as if carefully laid out to welcome the lady. Her arrival makes this night even more dazzling.

title: Dancing in Frost
description: Blades traced the glistening ice. With every deep bend, every leap and spin, she made a fiery declaration—to break free and reach for long-awaited flight. It was the beginning of her new journey.

title: Forest's Fluttering
description: In the verdant forest, emerald Sequin Wings gracefully dance with the breeze. A passionate entomologist observes their graceful moves, gently reaching for a net to capture this captivating moment.

title: Froggy Fashion
description: "The Croakers are the cherished, charming neighbors and friends of Florawish," Mayor Grace has noted. In celebration of this special bond, the town has launched the "Croaker" Fashion Style Award, and we are thrilled to unveil the most beloved design—the winner of the Best Popularity Award.

title: Moment Capturer
description: After the autumn rain, a gentle breeze swept away the gloom, bringing a refreshing breath. The girl's anticipation seemed to pause time, freezing the endless expanse of the countryside between her fingertips.

title: Moonlight Oath
description: The mysteries of the starry sky, the promises made under the moon, all of them fall silent with the end of the meteor shower. When life born from stars and moon decides not to linger anymore, the forest falls into complete tranquillity.

title: Timeless Echo
description: A young girl, who had traveled across vast oceans, bid farewell to her friends in a foreign land and embarked on the journey back alone. As the ship sailed away, the once-familiar faces gradually shrank into mere specks on the horizon, flooding her mind with memories.

title: Cloudbreak Stitches
description: Passing through every tear was like passing through one small, forgotten city after another. She mended the broken thread ends, as if mending corners bitten through by time. When she had mended the deepest, darkest place, she lifted her head and suddenly understood the loneliness in the Titan's eyes.

title: Dawn's Melody
description: In the symphony of strings and sounds, the tonic and appoggiatura are naturally in harmony, playing together the melody of day and night. Cruel fate insists on leaving the appoggiatura all alone. Who should pluck its strings, and how should it score a variation of its own?

title: Origin of Machinery
description: She gently awakens the machinery that has long been sealed in dust, and by following the gaps where gears mesh and energy circulates, she has a glimpse of the former glory of the Titans.

title: Timeless Dreamwings
description: Here, the flowers never wither, and the greenhouse shuts out wind and rain. She flutters lightly, like a beautiful butterfly. With no past to mourn and no distant horizons to pursue, a pair of tireless wings is what eternity looks like.

title: Dream's Silhouette
description: Fold timidity into the pleats of the dress, and sew anticipation into the lace. The petticoat gently supports her, along with a courage that's about to overflow. The gown is not meant to amaze anyone; it simply gives a voice to a tiny wish: "Can I be your friend?"

title: Distant Stars
description: The dancer moves through the wilderness, her outstretched arms tracing the arcs of birds and drifting clouds, starlight spilling across her shoulders. She turns toward the horizon, chasing the next unrestrained dance.

title: Tonight's Wind and Moon
description: Deep within the palace, the silhouette of a startled swan remains forever held. She was a dancer of the court, confined between the vermilion railings and jade masonry—until a night of crystalline wind and brilliant moonlight. In that hour, a wandering melody plucked at her heartstrings, and the ripples of fate began to stir in the silence.

title: Daughter of the Kingdom
evolution: Daughter of the Kingdom: Eternal Light
description: You must raise your sharp sword, stain your skirt with the soot of war, and go to that trampled battlefield, letting fear sing praises for your coronation. Their voices are not for you to heed; their pain is not for you to mind. Only thus can you be the princess of the kingdom.

title: Rewound Daydream
description: Curious, the girl steps into the waterfall that pours into a stream, exploring a dazzling, inverted world inside a box. The teapot is filled with red tea brewed from doubt, and the playing cards have no thickness.

title: Pulse of the Desert
description: She stepped into the desert for the first time. Wherever she went, the silks of spring tore apart before her eyes, and all things slid toward withering. Every living being that entered this place faded into secrecy, yet across the endless sea of sand, a river ran on without end.

title: Forgotten Songs
description: In the depths of the forest, the whispers of ancient trees echoed, the memories of which had long been erased by time. Now, when the wind calls, only fallen leaves answer back. They keep watch of the land while carrying vows long forgotten, waiting for new branches to sprout.

title: Melody Bloom
description: The paper cranes in the sky whispered of their travels across Wishfield. In time, new friendships were formed. With each encounter, came feelings as precious as gifts, with each warm moment, came blessings unspoken but well understood.

title: Purifying Wind
description: The arrow rested on a bow fully drawn, its fletching slightly trembling. The forest suddenly fell quiet, as if everything within was listening with bated breath. In the next second, a flash darted through the air and gloom, before melting into the sound of the wild wind.

title: Sunflower Chronicle
description: A long-awaited rain, an ever-burning fire on the summit, and seeds of grains riding on the wind. With these, the flowers nurtured with blood and tears would one day bloom under a new sun and bring hope to the land.

title: Blossoming Future
description: The stage shifts like surging waves, like a galaxy cascading from the heavens. Just as the starlit moon rises in majesty, her song takes the helm across time and space, weaving sound and color into the fabric of a dream.

title: Cheering Heartbeat
description: Some chase the spotlight to the beat of the drums, vying for the idol's throne. But she knocked on the door of the Dopamine Dance Club for herself... To rediscover the passion in her life and fall in love with herself again. Turns out, the most powerful cheer comes from finally learning to root for yourself.

title: From the Depth
description: The blind girl who wove seawater had never seen the boundless ocean, yet she met countless lost humans, tiny as water droplets, adrift in the vast sea of fate.

title: Gilded Memories
description: The grand and tranquil manor echoed with the soft whispers of the maids. The rustling among the trees stirred feelings, and a proper young lady stole a glance. Time quietly turned a page for the charming pair, and the long years unfolded in peaceful, contented days.

title: Honey Hunt
description: They linger in the orchard, aware of which blossoms will yield the sweetest fruit. Mila has come to understand the preferences of these little bees, and now, wherever they gather, she is sure to be there as well.

title: Springbloom Enchantment
description: After enduring the long rainy season, the rainbow adorns the Springblooms with vibrant hues. She gathers a handful of fragrant blooms, concealing the blossoming hope deep within her heart, wishing it to grow quickly and let the flourishing life sing free of worry.

title: Art of Tailoring
description: From the spark of curiosity at their first encounter to the flourishing tree that now nurtures endless inspiration... the gifted designer chose to embrace her artistry wholeheartedly, unleashing her unique style and boundless creativity.

title: Enchanted Writing
description: In the fleeting moments of her dreams, there was joyous music and dance, and at the center of the dance floor stood a human girl, with a bouncy little sheep. When the dream surfaced once again, she decided to pick up her pen and transform the dream into flowing words...

title: Pastoral Dance
description: Where has the Florist Sheep wandered off to today? As the shepherdess's bell rings like a sweet melody and hurried footsteps turn into a playful dance, a little sheep stumbles onto the dance floor. The girl chasing it becomes an unexpected guest at the Faewish Sprites' celebration...

title: Adventure Ride
description: Years later, she would still fondly recall that distant afternoon, racing alongside the Bullquet on her motorcycle.

title: Dream Banquet
description: As the fairytale goes, a lonely little princess once lived in a grand castle. She sat alone at an exquisite tea table, where, in the candlelight, she could see a lavish feast and a bustling crowd. She raised her glass, but there was no one to clink it with.

title: Spectral Mist
description: Midnight mist, like a dark veil, stretches across the expanse of time. As the hands of the clock turn backward, shifting light and shadow unveil the old poems once more. With each stroke of midnight, the legendary queen's ball begins anew.

title: Endless Longing
description: Dreams adrift, shadows adrift, a tune of longing, eyes brim with tears. Who shares this love of mine?

title: Enduring Bond
description: The mask and smoke herald the arrival of a mysterious figure, who will come before the moon rises to claim the hidden treasure of the island. With a steady and eager heart, accept this invitation letter.

title: Fiery Glow
description: The creator of the fireworks, sensing the solitude of the night, bestowed upon it the brilliance born from within.

title: Whispers of Bliss
description: On her tiny canvas, she captured a vibrant flower field, a basket of fruit, and a graceful girl nearby. With bold strokes, the girl's figure seemed ready to step out of the painting.

title: Starfall Radiance
description: Shooting stars that once illuminated Miraland still brighten the night skies today. They say wearing this dress and clasping your hands to make a wish will summon a shooting star to glide across the sky.

title: Dreamy Glimmer
description: "What lurks deep within the Well of Fortune? Croak, croak, croak, croak... A pink, round wanderer, bubbling with charm? Croak, croak, croak, croak..." No Croaker knows when this melody first echoed through the Well of Fortune.

title: Flowing Colors
description: As she dipped her brush into the colored paints, an unexpected scene suddenly unfolded before her eyes. A wave of inspiration surged through her heart, transforming what she saw from a simple landscape to an everlasting memory imprinted on her soul.

title: Rippling Serenity
description: While fishing, a gentle lake breeze caresses the surroundings, accompanied by the soft hum of nursery rhymes sung by nearby children. Time moves at a leisurely pace, and the fish swim with a graceful elegance.

title: Scaly Dream
description: The tail fin gleams like clouds and mist, unfolding abruptly, resembling an ink-splashed landscape awakening from ancient scriptures.

title: Shark Mirage
description: Why stick to the stereotype that fishing is all about peaceful moments? Explore the open sea instead! Take on the challenge of outsmarting the craftiest opponents lurking in the depths of the ocean!

title: Starlit Celebration
description: As the clock strikes midnight, a new page of the calendar unfolds. Every dewdrop gleams like a blessing, while the starry sky bears silent witness to this special moment.

title: Gilded Dreamsong
description: The Celebration Envoy was born from the sweetest dream. Golden sunlight wove her dazzling gown, and brilliant flowers kissed her pure cheeks. She was a close friend to every Shroomsera, bringing happiness and joy with a gentle flutter of her wings.

title: Unseen Colors
description: Ever since she was little, she knew what kind of paintings she wanted to create, and her dream was long layered in vibrant hues. But time is no endless canvas. How much more practice would it take to preserve the colors of flowers and leaves?

title: Veiled Projections
description: Cicia's flashbulbs exposed the light and shadow on the film, and the giant creatures from the dream began their endless pursuit. This time, where will your lens point?

title: Existence Paradox
description: The cold light on the workbench is silent and steady, as old parts are disassembled one by one, replaced, and restarted. The new Cogbud is nearly flawless, yet she thinks of the marks she has once repaired with her own hands, which seem nowhere to be found in this new shell.

title: Warm Miracles
description: The shimmering fabric colors the air, and Nikki's tiny dreams are tinged with a rainbow glow. The joy of whimsicality happily flaps its translucent wings, weaving into her own little kingdom through innocent brushstrokes and colors.

title: Steps Against Order
description: How difficult is it to become someone unconventional? Astrid has never asked herself that question. She never notices her own difference, nor does she look up to any external measure. She simply walks in the direction where the morning mist disperses, toward the far horizon she has chosen.

title: Evergreen Vow
description: Like tiny buds hidden beneath the snow, even if their strength is faint and their bodies have fallen into a deep slumber, they must raise their indomitable spirit and kindle their own unique radiance in the silent resting place.

title: Heartward Hues
description: Deep within a sea of flowers where the mist has yet to lift, the hidden young dragon reveals herself before the divine, claiming she has come in search of more colors. Yet color exists everywhere—why should it ever need to be sought?

title: Luster Covenant
description: The dragon bones from a thousand years ago awaken from their slumber, bridging the insurmountable cliffs and deep chasms with a wondrous path. Each piece fitted together is like unraveling a cryptic mystery...

title: Song of Embers
description: I awoke because of you; the gears turned for you. I thought we would sing in the castle forever, until that day you pushed open the window with your own hands, casting me into the winds of freedom while leaving yourself to the boundless fire...

title: Verdant Chord
description: With a clear, gentle heart, she senses the subtle emotions of every plant—rejoicing with each new bud breaking through the soil and sighing for every leaf drifting from its branch.

title: Whispered Dreams
description: The gift of destiny has become a healing power. With her hands, she soothes every restless soul, like the moon gently spilling its light over the world.

title: Covenant of Time
description: Hush, please listen to me! Time is the only weight that can measure desire. Give up everything, and let me grant your daughter a new life. But why do the screams from the depths of your soul entangle me so? As you wish, the price has become the warm embrace of a monster.

title: Echoes Upon the Gale
description: The clamor of the forest peels away from her ears, and the voices of all things fall into her palm, growing into lustrous pearls, wildflowers wet with morning dew, or mountain brooks flowing backward into a bottle. The girl looks up; the wind carries away the voices of old, and a story has begun to ripple.

title: Heart of the Deep Forest
evolution: Heart of the Deep Forest: Crescent Moon
description: When the moonlight stoops down to drape the night mist over the forest's breast, even the most playful children crawl into their beds, waiting for the final fairytale before saying goodnight. The silent guardian in the story, merciful and mighty, brings peace to the forest and dreams to all.

title: Night Capricorn Song
description: The fortune-teller's vague muttering hangs like a lowered velvet curtain, veiling the dim stars of the night sky. The girl accepts the withered prophecy and walks toward her fate, her footprints hesitant and blurred.

title: The Fifth Flavor
description: Celily despises the rigid beauty of "Perfect Idol." She tears the dull script to shreds and imagines a rebellious "Pastry Witch," clad in a one-of-a-kind baker's uniform, rewriting her own legend through mischief.

title: Visionary Dreamer
description: Her gaze passed over the signpost, tracing the texture of the land and the pulse of the forest. One blueprint after another surged vividly in her mind, and then, before her eyes, the world unfolded.

title: Formless Truth
description: The artisan spread out the sketches, the brush drifting through conflicting records—ink rich, then dry, until it finally failed. After exhaustive study, the true form still remained elusive. Worse yet, the drafts lay unfinished, the vision unclear, even the simplest strokes caught in hesitation.

title: Moonlit Immortal
description: Her soul burned brightly, reflecting her graceful form. Her spirit persisted, swirling with heaven and earth. She danced until emotion shook her heart, until desire burst open, and even as her body decayed, her dance remained unbroken.

title: Nefarious Shadows
description: Petals drifted through the air like floating incense, as fireworks crowned the long street bright, the crowds surging, ceaseless and alive. Red fish shimmered in the water's glow, where wavering shadows lingered, moving slow. In the curling smoke, hidden paths appeared in fleeting glimpses. Lose not your way among the ornate towers. Still your gaze—for the wavering lantern light hides secrets yet to be seen.

title: Perfect Moment
description: Hesitant in thought, timid in speech, her wise heart remained hidden in her room. With silver scissors she cut new paper flowers, creating her own cherished moments in a hidden realm of red paper beyond the mortal world.

title: Poem of Emberlight
description: She listened to the forest's legends, planting the fervent wish to protect within the soil of hope. She felt lost amid the doubts of the mundane world, letting voices weave sorrow into her tender heart, until the flame offered its guidance, until a faint light stirred the long-held stillness.

title: Song Beyond
description: Resting among mist and clouds, drinking wind and dew, she grew accustomed to watching the world, long gazing toward the lantern lights of mortal life. Within moonlit grace and before branching boughs, a single glance had already inscribed her fate upon the scroll of the mortal world.

title: Tasting the World
description: She walked thousands of miles, and tasted delicacies from across the world. Exquisite dishes passed her lips, and she could distinguish every nuanced flavor. Her tongue was like a sword, her pen like a brush; she reviewed over three thousand recipes. Chefs, big and small, competed to serve banquets, seeking her golden words of praise.

title: Thousand Flames
description: Amid the mundane rush of daily life, walking familiar paths of worn stone, a sudden insight stirred. Half-awake from the haze, clouds and mist fell away, and the full moon was revealed at the heart of the sky.

title: Dancing Pearl
description: She once fell from the stars' adoration into sharp, piercing ridicule, yet stubbornly clung to that pure white dress. From that moment, Elderwood Forest gained an exquisite moon, quietly shielding all the lonely souls who were like her.

title: Solitary Silhouette
description: Breathing with all living things until the morning light awoke, she glided like mist across the shadows of leaves. At the moment the last light vanished, her solitary figure became a silent presence perched on ancient branches, an indistinct visage watching over everything.

title: Verdant Verse
description: The bard's song drifted across endless lands, never lingering in any forest, until she walked alongside the Behemoth. Its silent eyes mirrored hers, its massive form bowed in attentive listening. When its horn lightly touched her tambourine, the forest learned the language of poetry.

title: Deepwood Dream
description: The Cadenceborn softly recited a poem, recalling a memory that lingered in his heart. Those dreamlike years of a long journey, when he once sang of friendship, and time flowed gently by, as if the joy could last forever.

title: Feathery Song
description: The desolate plains slumbered, smoothing out the wrinkles of the ancient land. Eagles flew by, stirring the pale moonlight. Following the legend, it led to a treasure in a place of golden prosperity. As feathers quivered in Elderwood Forest, a new adventure had already begun.

title: Forest Folk
description: A giant, puffy Nikki stunned a Behemoth with her roar and rescued the trapped Shroomlings. This is not a made-up story.

title: Forest's Song
description: The Shawl Deer had already started its lonesome journey across Itzaland before Veilfall. Its eyes reflected the lively, gentle earth, yet it never allowed itself to get close, as if it were an onlooker whose sole purpose was to walk, gaze, and witness history.

title: Shadow Swiftweave
description: With her Sticky Claw, Nikki can zoom across Spira while riding the forest wind, quietly watching the Shroomlings live their simple yet joyous lives.

title: Silent Ode
description: She was devout in her faith, singing hymns to the divine maiden beneath the tower day and night, never once faltering. Many times she looked up at the tower, meeting the divine maiden's gaze, but the shadow within them eluded her understanding; still, she believed that one day she would grasp its meaning.

title: Starwoven Dreams
description: The dancer had been to every corner of the land, a free spirit whose moves came from the heart. With countless unbelievable anecdotes under her belt, she arrived in Spira, where the mystery of a strange girl who lived alone attracted her keen attention.

title: Sweet Waltz
description: Before Veilfall, a group of optimistic and adorable Shroomlings lived in Elderwood Forest. They frolicked, rolled in mud, and waved their bug nets around. In their carelessness, they ran into a sleeping Behemoth, which kickstarted a cute and thrilling escape.

title: Counterflow Concerto
description: Musical notes traced her path of growth. Once trembling on a piano, now rising from the rhythm of drums. The melodies she composed told her story, sometimes pure and clear like morning dew, sometimes blazing like fireworks.

title: Golden Buds
description: Applause surged like waves, wrapping around every hardship, from sunlight to spotlight, from the streets to the grand stage. As the lights came on, the threads of their outfits shimmered with the rhythm of day and night. The Lorelei Troupe was about to present a magnificent chapter in song and splendor!

title: Starry Nocturne
description: A dust-speckled star flicked its tail into a trail of notes, and moonlight gently lit up her skirt, as the whole universe cheered. Guided by childhood dreams, she cherished this tiny stage beneath her feet, gripped the mic, and sang her very first note.

title: Gossamer Moonfairy
description: Her smile bloomed like a flower, yet she loved to change like the wind. Cunning beasts and clever hares, seeking, wandering, pausing, and moving on. May her art repay these tales, persisting through endless ages.

title: Lifetime Yin Yuan
description: Night upon night, petals pierced dreams' embrace—hairpins of crimson dotting souls with grace. A thousand years lent, now Yin Yuan's due, returning fragrance to those who once knew.

title: Lotus Heart
description: A solitary figure among cold waves, cleansing dust with clear ripples. Yin Yuan entwined, awakening a yearning for the mortal realm. From afar, they watched life being stirred by the sudden rain, a dream finally coming awake, asking the heavens and earth, "Can this lotus's heart be borne across?"

title: Sword Master
description: You say our home has turned to ash, I say its hills still live in ink. A thousand years breathe beneath my brush, the moon and willows warm each dream.

title: Thought in Bloom
description: In the healer's garden, even the herbs grew with quiet compassion. They sheltered fledgling butterflies from the rain, guided lost sprouts toward the light, and became a spark of life upon the wounded earth. Their roots lay deep in the soil, a silent echo of kindness that never faded from the world.

title: Mistbound Whispers
description: Amid the fine drizzle and drifting fog, she looked ethereal. With a gentle sweep of her umbrella, she guided the lost on their way. But everything was only a mirage in the mist. By dawn, the memories of the night would fade away.

title: Nightlight Whispers
description: Wanting my friend to sleep well, the hours spent keeping watch alone no longer felt long. Watching your steady breaths melt into the evening breeze, the night lamp gently lit your sweet dreams. The wish to protect needs no words because the silent Knitmoth has already understood for you.

title: Celestial Whispers
description: The storm-tossed night sky settles into peace. Cradled by the drifting wind, it glides toward the island of dreams, shrouded in clouds and bubbles. Quick, open your eyes—this is the adventure woven by the moon and stars.

title: Harvest's Blessing
description: The joy of the harvest spills over by the bonfire gathering. The fruits of the girl's childhood dreams, once only imagined, have now ripened on the branches and are held in her hands. She lifts her gaze and finds her friend, who, like her, has returned, strengthened by the shared dreams that brought them back together.

title: Rosy Reverie
description: The cheers from the dream city swell like the tide, surrounding her from morning to night. But as the day's clamor fades and the crowds disperse, only lingering ashes remain, leaving the weary soul to reflect.

title: Water's Echo
description: The water flows gently, footsteps rustling in its wake. Each day, the girl runs along the riverbank, chasing its winding trail. She remembers the timing for sowing the fields, the warning of a coming storm—delivering the river's prophecy to every heart yearning for a rich harvest.

title: The Queen's Move
description: One of the most popular stories in the picture books of the Heartcraft Kingdom is about the Queen's Chess: from the moment she first achieved victory, she knew this game was tailor-made for her.

title: Midnight Vigil
description: With resolve and honor, the Floofs stood behind her in a perfect line. The tranquil, enchanting Isles captured her gaze, and she swore to become an unwavering light, glowing day and night while guarding the midnight hours.

title: New Bloom Blessings
description: With red robes and gold-threaded blessings, we celebrate the arrival of the new year. Prayers for harmony and prosperity, for joy to linger, and health year by year.

title: New Year's Dawn
description: Leaning against the sleepless dawn, I raise my head to watch crimson fireworks bloom across the sky. With a soothing flute melody, I let the notes weave through the thousands of lights, winding their way through the familiar alleys I know so well.

title: Verdant Melodies
description: Wandering along Silken Lake, a gentle breeze stirs, setting the lake's surface aglow with shimmering light. She gathers the scattered flowers and weave them, one by one, into a tapestry of romance, adorning the vibrant scenes along the picnic path with fresh, radiant blossoms.

title: Dream-Like Night
description: A soft pillow shielded people from tomorrow, and fluffy feathers veiled all sleepless troubles. The charming rogue transformed into a knight guarding dreams: "Sleep, fugitive of reality. Problems dissolve in the night, and answers reveal themselves in dreams."

title: Glimmering Forest
description: So even red could breathe softly—at this moment it spread into a small dome. Glowing spores danced upon it like firefly stars, drifting without rest. Two gentle lights swayed nearby, illuminating the legends of the forest.

title: Sweet Memories
description: The scent of herbs and the shadow of her mother drifted away with the wind, leaving only the cake's sweetness behind. Clutching her longing, she wiped her tears, determined to preserve that aroma, letting the memory of her mother protect it against the harsh winds of time.

title: Woodland Nesting
description: She swatted the low-hanging branches and entered an accidental adventure caused by a lost item. The bird carried fresh green from the forest, its wings brushing the sunlight. She let it guide her, as the wind led her on a new journey.

title: Cloud Reverie
description: She hid behind the stage, illuminating the center with her imagination and inventions, until the applause and lights fell silent, and confusion crystallized into introspection. Suddenly, the clouds and dew brought sunlight, illuminating paths she had yet to tread.

title: Courtyard Flowers
description: Pushing open the door tangled with branches, she stepped into the secret childhood realm woven for her with flowers and dew. You told her the name of every flower, and narrated the fairy tales of distant lands. Slowly, fragrant wishes took root in her heart.

title: Grains of Yesterday
description: Amid a boundless flow of golden light, a small figure ran along the field's edge, her loose braids dancing in the wind. Above the sunlit waves of wheat, her carefree youth unfolded.

title: Daughter of the Lake
description: With her tail transformed into legs, she steps forward, racing toward freedom like a shooting star. Only when raindrops dampen her skin, and new scales begin to form, does she faintly recall her days as a Ribbon Eel in Silken Lake.

title: Gleaming Dance
description: Under the dazzling lights of the graduation ball, the girl twirled gracefully in a dress she designed herself, like a blooming flower of the night.

title: Pink Ribbon Waltz
description: On a rainy day, a girl dances on her toes by the lake, scales shimmering on her damp skin as if she's become a lively fish, gliding toward her sea of dreams.

title: Afternoon Shine
description: Picture a bright, sunlit afternoon in spring, where you and your best friend chase bugs in a grassy field. Let go of all concerns, laugh wholeheartedly, and feel the warmth of the sunlight embracing your heart.

title: Breezy Tea Time
description: On a lovely afternoon filled with the aroma of black tea, a Bowtie Cat lazily squints, settling into a gentle nap. Little does it know, it's about to be groomed with care.

title: Bubbly Voyage
description: Once bubbles are formed, they start a carefree journey. Floating up and drifting ahead, they go wherever they wish.

title: Far and Away
description: The elegant script on the first page of the diary reads: "To you, my future self—let's set sail for the boundless unknown! Go chase the farthest horizons and the dreams that ignite our souls!"

title: Floral Memory
description: I feel like I'm a drifting petal carried by the wind, casting a fleeting shadow over vast meadows beneath the starlit sky.

title: Fully Charged
description: Keep electrical maintenance knowledge in mind, and step forward when there's a power outage. Get fully charged!

title: Hometown Breeze
description: The ever-present wind, relentless day and night, never fades away. It weaves its way through the towering Stonetrees and softly caresses the wide open plains. Wherever people's journey takes them, their homeland's call beckons whenever the wind blows.

title: Rebirth Wish
description: Lilina's inauguration as mayor begins under the watchful and hopeful eyes of the people. The dawn soothes the scars of Florawish, and the paper cranes unfold their wings to hold up a new story.

title: Starlet Burst
description: A Faewish Sprite says that wearing this can make a massive visitor shrink, as tiny as they can be! But the ability to fly doesn't come with the package.

title: Sweet Jazz Nights
description: Carrying a letter of invitation from a Bibcoon, you knock softly on the door of the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club at midnight. Inside, an endless stream of jazz awaits its audience.

title: Wind of Purity
description: Perhaps the spring breeze is the world's first bard, its verses echoing across the spring meadows, purifying the land and bringing new lives.

title: Danqing Craft
description: Unrolling the scroll and setting ink to paper, every thought of the heart was traced. With brush in hand, each stroke brought the landscape before the artist's eyes to life. One by one, every scene unfurled at the tip of the brush.

title: Momo Rain
description: Tip-tap, raindrops fall, and Momo's little adventure begins! What mysteries await him at the end of the glistening, rain-kissed road?

title: Bye-Bye Dust
description: With aromatic foam and splashing droplets, everything's ready. Little critters, it's bath time, and we're aiming for squeaky-clean perfection!

title: Starwish Echoes
description: Once a garment symbolizing the miracles of Millewish Sprites, woven from the aspirations of countless souls, it now rests within the Temple of Wishes, entombing the dust-laden memories of a bygone era.

title: Symphony of Strings
description: Music flows over the strings as arms trace the course of the melody. Each note is like a fleeting heartbeat, woven into a captivating symphony.

title: Winter Flame
description: A relentless snowstorm may freeze your limbs, but hope and belief burn inside like a fierce fire, driving you forward.

title: Feather's Trail
description: A gentle breeze drifts through the forest. While searching for the Sky Monarch, the girl unexpectedly finds a lone feather. Is this a chance encounter—or a special invitation from the forest?

title: Summer Stroll
description: Imagine being a wandering heroine strolling through deserts, with a brandished sword and a river reflecting the setting sun in the background. How cool is that?

title: Spotlight Pink
description: She was a walking storm of fashion, the most dazzling shopping queen among her friends, an ever-shining party queen. Her new and limited-edition outfits were trophies, testaments to her bold style. Wherever she stood, the stage belonged to her.

title: Lotus Fate
description: In the first light of dawn, as the mist lifted, the Rouge Lotus awakened from its slumber. When the first crimson bloom unfurled like rosy morning clouds, an unbreakable Yin Yuan with her was forged.

title: Midnight Vogue
description: In the stillness of the night, a striking figure gradually emerges. A brief glance over her shoulder reveals a sharp, enigmatic gaze, lending an air of effortless rebellion to her presence.

title: Floating Blossoms
description: If the young girl were to choose a place to rest, it would undoubtedly be the grassy meadow by the lake. Entwined in vibrant blooms, with the grass brushing against her knees and a soft breeze caressing her face, she could find no greater comfort than the tranquility of that moment.

title: Rosie Sweetheart
description: With a free-spirited attitude, a sweet touch, a hint of coolness, and just the right amount of rebellious charm... Perfect—today, she reigns as the queen of black-pink fashion!

title: The Perfectionist
description: The vibrant stage is carefully decorated with layers of elements—lights, venue, models, clothes—all essential. In this moment, a sharp, meticulous eye is crucial to ensure every detail is flawless.

title: Chic Elegance
ja_name: スマートな身だしなみ
description: A stylist who had traveled far and wide across Wishfield once put forth the Improved School Uniform Manifesto. Alongside this manifesto, a meticulously refined version of the classic uniform was unveiled to the public.

title: Monster Girl
description: Just before setting off on her quest for that Trick-o-Bag, what's going through the mind of our "Monster Girl" who loves nothing more than Trick-o-Bag?

title: Quirky Idea
description: The girl's mind soars beyond the limits of the ordinary. Driven by an unyielding experimental spirit, she single-handedly brings light to the unexplored corners of Esseling research.

title: Woolfruit Siesta
description: Long ago, Woolfruit Trees yielded bountiful Woolfruit, nourishing the need for clothing in times of scarcity. Today, Veilfall is but a faint echo in the past, yet Woolfruit Trees still stand tall, casting welcoming shades over weary travelers.

title: Colorful Shroomagic
description: Hello, I'm Jon-78, and I'm delighted to help you with styling! How about using the dessert shop's newly baked treats as inspiration for this design? I'm so excited and I can already smell that sweet aroma!

title: Gold-Seeking Night
description: On the night of the full moon, the Golden Court was patrolled at night. The master thief from Cicia failed to steal the treasure she had long yearned for, yet inadvertently snatched the faint sound belonging to a cog.

title: Songwoven Plumes
description: They met amid the clamor of dawn and accompanied each other through countless tranquil nights filled with soaring strings and songs. Love gave flesh and blood to decayed hearts and made silent souls sing of hope. Beneath the gentle moonlight, gears turned out a melody, opening a chapter of new life.

title: Heroic Legend
description: For generations, some heroes crossed savage lands to achieve their dreams... The light of their glory inspired others to walk the same path, yet no one could see the flowers raised in tears in their shadow.

title: Seasonal Colors
description: I want the sunlight. I want the fields of flowers. I want the colors of the seasons to follow my skirt forever. Unknowingly, I stole the colors. I let greed become a sin. I made the seasons gray, and I cannot let go. Quickly, apologize to the world; quickly, give all the colors back!

title: Self-Rule
description: The laws of city civilization teach her to hide her animal ears and grind down her fangs, to blend into the crowd like a drop of water in the sea. Staying orderly and dutiful is the way to survive. But if she loses her savage edge, how can she ever be herself?

title: Proof on Stage
description: The true criminal and stage guards met face to face—continue performing or make the arrest? Let the lights shine! The sword in hand guided the guards through the crowd—onward, onward! A performance of truth and illusion began.

title: Guardian Floof
description: Legends speak of a magical protective charm hidden within the small whirlwind of a wagging tail. The Floof found the lonely girl and, gently and steadfastly, returned warmth and courage to her hands.

title: Moonlit Rewind
description: As the gramophone spun songs from half a century past, the pale-gold dress twirled once more beneath the moonlight, and two midsummers became one on that night. All that had gone before became but a prologue, and the quietly lost youth stirred awake within the music.

title: Immeasurable Findings
description: In that ancient, chaotic, lively, and dramatic place, there were things that even her meticulously designed instruments couldn't measure, like trust between people.

title: Momo Power
description: The brave girl never feared the unknown road ahead. Thanks to her best friend's company, there was never a dull moment on her journey.

title: Flawless Vision
description: Giving it your all and never letting a single fleeting moment of inspiration slip away. That's the only way to become a perfect architect!

title: Perpetual Dance
description: Take her hand, lead her into the dance, and finish together with a graceful, unbound bow. Don't abandon it all. Let the dance be a fleeting moment, keep your head down, and allow the curtain to fall.

title: Star Memory
description: A gentle breeze swept across the grass like rolling waves, while faint starlight drifted and flickered here and there, shining and fading in turn. Steady your steps, catch that lost speck of light, protect it, and save it! Because this star cares, and that star cares too!

title: Nimble Cat
description: A slender figure, graceful bearing, and an air of captivating charm... Yet these words did not describe a model or a celebrity, but rather a Bowtie Cat by the roadside, pouncing after butterflies!

title: Starry Path
description: The idol on the stage seemed like a tireless dream-weaver, the gems on the costume shimmering like starlight, casting their glow into every child's deepest dream.

title: Sweet Rhapsody
description: A modestly famous idol decided to attend her friend's concert. She dressed in a "low-key" fashion, declined her bodyguard's escort, slipped past the fans, and headed out excitedly.

title: Misty Poetics
description: As the rainy season arrives, deep alleys are shrouded in a dream-like mist, yet it's now that the purple flowers awaken.

title: Sky Supplier
description: The dolls living on the floating island have elected a new sky supplier... none other than their beloved little bear doll!

title: Sweet Diagnosis
description: She dons her brand-new, pink uniform, and consistently hones her communication skills with the children. Standing before a mirror, she perfects her smile, as sweet as candy. Every ounce of her effort is devoted to helping the little patients feel at ease when being treated.

title: Dream Chaser
description: Cycling, designing, cycling, designing—day after day... With each draft she sketches and every mile she rides, she carves a steady path toward her dream, gaining strength and courage along the way.

title: Pink Bunny
ja_name: ふわふわピンクウサギ
description: There's a riddle children know well: What's pink, fluffy, has a round tail, and loves to hop?

title: Nighttime Whisper
description: The tale of the mountain spirit was softly told by candlelight and whispered in the night: in the deep mountains, though no one roams, the paths are guided. When the girl is trapped in thick fog, the warmth of her loved one's protection appears like a faint glow, leading her back home.

title: Path's Farewell
description: The scent after the rain mixed with the earthy aroma of soil and the fragrance of plants, while a soft breeze carried a hint of coolness along the path she walked. The city was saying goodbye to her in its own way.

title: Homebound Letters
description: Three thousand miles separated her from home, and twenty sparse lines of letters could not convey the storm in her heart. When the news of the harvest arrived, the traveler returned home soon thereafter.

title: Path of Starlight
description: As the stars drift off to sleep, she steps away from work and sets out for home. The world rests in silence, with only her footsteps and heartbeat softly marking her journey.

title: Star of the Gala
description: There is a well-known secret in the high society's evening galas: "If you're lucky enough to catch the eye of that mysterious lady, your path to success is assured!"

title: Bibcoon Realm
description: What's the first thing you gotta do when you come to Bibcoon's Chuckle Club? Pet those enthusiastic Bibcoons, of course!

title: Bright Days
description: My mom used to sing a nursery rhyme that goes, "Raise a Blossom Beetle, and floral dresses will never be far." Whenever she catches sight of a Florapom across the meadow, the girl just can't resist running over to take a look—though this marks her 214th time scaring away the Blossom Beetle.

title: Cozy Adventure
description: The chill is in the air, so it's time to get busy! Capture a few Sockos and craft a cozy outfit with their soft, warm fur to brave the cold winds.

title: Whimsical Picnic
description: It's picnic season again! The girl invites a few dear friends and embarks on a romantic journey, embracing the beauty of nature every step of the way.

title: Sporty Sweetheart
description: The pink color, playful bows, and heart patterns won't slow me down—I'll run as fast as lightning!

title: Dreamveil Hymn
description: The musician was carried by thunderous applause onto an unattainable stage, then lost herself completely in the jungle of fame and fortune. Only when the strings were stained with blood and the applause fell silent did she hear her own heartbeat again in the silence.

title: Stellar Banquet
description: A Titan designer's regret, left unfinished in an old scroll, was discovered a thousand years later by a stylist who happened upon the manuscript, helping her break through a creative block. An obsession born beneath the stars crossed time and space, and at last shone in full brilliance.

title: Contrarian March
description: They always say her colors are too loud, that her steps are too reckless—as if anyone cared. She wears everything she loves all at once, splashing violent, clashing colors across the canvas of rules, turning the world's noise into a contrarian march.

title: Pinecone Encounter
description: Deep in the pine woods is a tree hollow, hiding the most perfect today. Round Buttoncones hang high; all of time revolves around this moment, waiting for her to pluck and swallow it. The wishing girl is growing up, but the looping world does not answer.

title: Fading Melody
description: The early death of a genius always invites sorrow, and vicious rumors spread from mouth to mouth. The guide harbors no jealousy, and only the music can speak for her, telling a flawless tale of remembrance and longing.

title: Ingenious Maker
description: With light steps, she bustles about the tiny restaurant, dreaming of building something of her own. She doesn't yet know that even without a spotlight on stage, countless people will still fall in love with her smile.

title: Guiding Falling Stars
description: Those tiny wishes that slip away will always be picked up, treasured, and placed back in the palm of your hand. Hold them tight, as if grasping a falling star, following its light until you step out of the shadow of illness, and step into the fields of hope.

title: Burning Heart
description: The name "Miss Titan" came from a noble family in the Heartcraft Kingdom. She and her family shared an interest in civilizations that existed before Veilfall. After finding a book on the Titans, she embarked on a journey to Itzaland.

title: Fuzzy Affection
description: The passionate Skirt Tails, the proud Masquerade Lynxes, the clumsy Brush Beavers—all acted unusually relaxed around her, as if she were part of their world.

title: Mark of Time
description: In the dim cave, she traced the cold patterns of the stone slabs, her fingertips brushing beneath the soft fabric. When she stepped into the sunlight, the departed, seeing through her eyes, glimpsed the world of the living once more.

title: Mysterious Adventurer
description: The design of this outfit was inspired by one of the designer's thrilling encounters in Spira. She went out on a night stroll in search of inspiration, but ended up bumping into a nearby Behemoth. Fortunately, a masked "mysterious stranger" saved her from the maws of certain doom, in a moment she would never forget.

title: Puppet Play
description: Midnight falls, and the puppet opera troupe takes the stage on their tour! The slumbering puppets return for a limited-time "revival," dancing and singing in splendid, whimsical revelry. As long as the performance goes on, the secrets in the box remain silent as ever.

title: Stardew Valley Encounter
ja_name: スターデューバレー奇縁
description: The Junimo joyfully bounds across the farm, weaving together the golden sunrise, the shimmering night sky of Stardew Valley, and countless stories into a precious gift for Nikki.

title: Midnight Gleam
description: The bright evening star sways gently, and the tender moonlight tilts with it, drawing back the curtain on a one-of-a-kind ceremony. Though an unexpected twist disrupted the girl's plan, her soft heart still found endless possibilities within it. "After all," she said, "this is my ceremony."

title: Bubble's Hometown
description: The children's book "Bubble's Hometown" opens with: "Whether big or small, every bubble has its own hometown." From there, it unfolds the tale of the bubbles in the lake.

title: Golden Hour
description: When the warm, humid breeze sweeps across every inch of Stonewoods, the golden-hued flowers sway in response to the wind's call, dancing softly.

title: Carefree Moments
description: She strolls around on a sunlit afternoon, exploring the hidden places of the marketplace, listening to the city's unique rhythm and heartbeat.

title: Snowy Fragrance
description: Amid winter's embrace in a far-off land, snow gently covers the blossoms on the whitened branch, creating a tranquil harmony.

title: Sunlit Grasspom
description: The young girl steps forward, following the bright sunshine. The cheerful bird songs blend with the gentle murmur of the stream, and the soft Grasspoms by the roadside witness her courageous and determined stride.

title: Moment of Spring
description: Plant a single seed of hope, and wait for the gentle morning light to spill across the windowsill. Wait for the migratory birds to return in flocks. Wait for the one in your heart to return with the spring.

title: Snail Message
description: Through her brother's vivid tales—the sprawling Spira, thrilling adventures, vibrant foreign creatures, and their unique ways of life—she felt an irresistible pull, as if an unseen invitation was urging her to pursue what lay beyond.

title: Sweet Traces
description: Who's fast asleep? Gentle moonlight drifts past the window, softly pausing the pendulum. Is this a dream? Or an unforgettable taste. Bit by bit, sugar sprinkles fill the dream, layer upon layer, leaving a mark of tonight.

title: Daisy Murmurs
description: A tiny daisy seed fell at the heart of the field. Curious, she gathered this little world into her gaze and, before laughter arrived, dreamed of harvest and of growing up. Little by little, she began to sprout.

title: Wheat & Sunlight
description: She softly breathed as the golden wheat and azure sky blended into the fabric. Clearly, it was the wind of her homeland, carrying the sunlight of the harvest, brushing in from her childhood, and guiding her along a bright path.

title: Snowy Encounter
description: "Those who help others with sincerity are met with the world's truest gifts." Closing her storybook, the girl watched fragments of the tale turn to snowflakes, drifting her into a shimmering dream world.

title: First Love
description: It is not just the fleeting moments of their date that she cherishes, but the heartfelt efforts she put into preparing herself to shine brightly for that special time together.

title: Unseen Entity
description: When using a certain design tool of the Starhail Federation, gray and white squares mean transparency. Ever feel tongue-tied? Slip into this "Invisible Person" outfit and maybe you'll find the courage to introduce yourself.

title: Peachy Bond
description: As the peach and plum trees reach full bloom, transitioning from spring to summer, friendships have already matured into the sweetest memories.

title: Sweet-Cool Clash
description: The young souls burned with passion as they raced toward the distant dream in their hearts. Their bond, a kindred respect beyond victory or defeat, became a cherished sentiment passed down through the ages.

title: Afternoon Blossom
description: In the private courtyard of the Heartcraft Kingdom, flowers sway as sweet scents drift on the breeze. The girl eases her friend's worries with a carefully prepared afternoon tea.

title: Chromatic Comet
description: In the night, the sound of running echoes without end: a figure chasing the stars, radiant beyond compare. Hesitate no more—come, and join this adventure of fantasy.

title: Unfettered Meadow
description: The designers of the Heartcraft Kingdom, deeply inspired by Libella, realized that true elegance is the ability to remain oneself and move freely in any environment.

title: Floating Cloud Dreams
description: Lost in Elderwood Forest, she stumbles instead upon a new adventure. The girl falls into the soft feathers of a Sky Monarch. The ground rushes away beneath her, and the confining maze unfurls into a landscape of freedom. In this vast yet tender dream, she finds her way home.

title: Lotus Whispers
description: She blends her gentle beliefs into perfume, only to see fragrance bottled inside anxiety. When incense no longer brings peace, she chooses to leave. Returning everything to the lake, she watches lotus petals open and close freely in the morning light, listening as nature hums.

title: Windowsill Whispers
description: By candlelight, she flipped through yellowed tomes, while a pair of eyes watched silently from the windowsill. Day after day, she and the bird shared this quiet companionship. Knowledge unfolded like chapters, and friendship took root softly and unnoticed.

title: Call of the Sea
description: Verdante took inspiration from schools of fish and waves, and designed this light, comfortable outfit that embodies the wildness of nature and the feeling of the sea.

title: Lush Waltz
description: Verdante took the design of an adventurer from the Heartcraft Kingdom, and added a touch of wildness to its elegant style, a choice inspired by Yara's wild yet graceful dance.

title: Mist Singer
description: The girl had come from the Heartcraft Kingdom, crossing mountains and rivers to reach the "Gale Clan" in the oasis of the Terra Alliance, only to hear, within the morning mist, that long-lost voice.

title: Sound of Leaves
description: Hide in a pile of leaves and listen to the critters. The sound of a satisfied baby Behemoth rolling in fallen leaves, Shroomlings traveling along a forest path... Who will walk by this pile of leaves next?

title: Twilight Finale
description: The lights came on, and the melody faded—her final piece was complete. The delayed applause erupted, a return to the beginning, yet she seemed unaware. Bowing, she left the stage, slipping through the restless crowd into the rainy night, never once looking back.

title: Meadow Symphony
description: Sometimes, an accidental note opens one's ear. A secret melody drifts through the world, spreading like wild grass, growing like towering trees, and flowing like a mountain stream. When notes touch the stars, all ears awaken. Listen... It's the voice of the green meadow!

title: Spring Blossom
description: Diligently tilling the soil, carefully planting, and patiently watering. In the end, the blossoms she had nurtured with her own hands bloomed from the earth, offering the devoted gardener the warmest gift of spring.

title: Swallow Whispers
description: She penned countless plays effortlessly, yet the memory that lingered most was of a paper kite, soaring like a startled swan. The string, held in her younger sister's hand, threaded through her youth, scripts, and stage, and into her silvered years. During the revival, she looked into her sister's eyes, as clear as in her childhood.

title: Hidden Light
description: Nameless, faceless, silent—uncertain fate. A lonesome moon, a solitary heart, a shadow wandering worlds apart. By a twist of fate, a pure hand sought death but found grace. Now even solitude, once fierce and blind, may sever threads of bygone time.

title: Among Bamboo Shadows
description: Walking through the bamboo grove, the rustling of leaves was soft and light. The distant fog and hometown slowly faded away, carrying with them the noise of a bustling world.

title: All-Night Party
description: The joyous celebration is about to begin—are you ready? Join the clown and turn every day into an extraordinary festival!

title: Childhood Moments
description: As a child, time felt slow and endless, brimming with laughter and joy. Yet when she looked back, that golden afternoon had already settled into the depths of her memory, anchored in the eternally-flowing stream of time.

title: Fruity Wish
description: Under the soft glow of the moon, she stood quietly in a corner of the orchard, her gaze lingering on the young, thriving saplings. The fruits hanging from the branches before her offered a sweet glimpse of the future that blossomed within her heart.

title: Jade Dreams
description: The camera captures the young girl's graceful figure, dressed in a dark green gown, like a forest fairy stepping into a grand feast on Earth. In this dazzling spotlight, she is the sole focus.

title: Carnival Ode
description: In Chloe's diary, there's a line that reads, "There should be an ode, dedicated to memory, to life, to home, and to the simple beauties around us."

title: Departing Blossom
description: Dear Fading Faewish Sprites, go embrace that final glimmer of ethereal blue. As the light dot blossoms like white flowers across the land, it will guide you back to the embrace of the divine.

title: Refined Grace
description: Formal yet relaxed, exquisite but understated, the subtle details of the simple color give each wearer a professional aura. It's said to be designed by Aderinna, the Sovereign of Cool.

title: School Days
ja_name: クローゼットの思い出
description: Not everyone keeps an old school uniform in their closet, but most people hold dear the memories of their uniforms and their youthful days.

title: Sweet Honey
description: All geared up and kitchen tools ready! Are you ready to turn the honey crafted by Foodie Bees into sweet candies?

title: Maiden's Garden
description: I wish I had my own garden. Flowers might not make a sound as they bloom, but their beauty says more than words ever could.

title: Sweet Slumber
description: As I count sheep to fall asleep, the little lambs hear my call and join me on a journey to a sunny dream.

title: Fish Tales
description: Folding gentleness into tiny paper boats, she set them afloat on the tranquil waters under the cover of night. Flickering silhouettes drifted apart and gathered together, and from then on, life became solitude, while the waterbed filled with moonlight.

title: Heartfelt Melody
description: The metronome ticks in time with the chords, as the clock's hands and the melody move in quiet harmony. The pen grazes the paper like a conductor's baton, guiding a silent symphony into a grand overture.

title: Perfect Start
description: Pink for curiosity, white for bravery—a whole new me is ready for the journey.

title: A Beautiful Day
description: It's said that this school uniform was designed by the Sovereign of Elegance when she was young, representing her innocent school days.

title: Guard's Resolve
description: Regardless of your status, the moment you put it on, it comes with accompanying responsibilities. The courage prepared for this moment bestows glory upon the guard. Move forward in a disciplined manner, get ready for remarkable performance.

title: Scarlet Dream
description: It was said that the Wishcraft Lab had plans to collaborate with human researchers. Upon catching wind of this potential collaboration, Chief Researcher Nunabo sprang into action and spent the entire night designing a dress perfect for commuting and work.

title: Searching for Dreams
description: That renowned Piecey, known as a master of sexy styling, once had an encounter with a girl. Back then, she had not yet become a famous star, but her determination and courage were truly inspiring. To commemorate their meeting and honor her bravery, this outfit was created.

title: Warm Holiday
description: Holidays arrive, smiles abound, belly full of sumptuous feasts, and blessings for a prosperous year. Leave all worries for tomorrow, return to the warm embrace of home, and she is a carefree child once more.

title: Rippling Reverie: Notturno
description: There will always be dark and stormy moments on the journey, but countless versions of "her" inside the bubbles are pushing away the raging winds and rain, time and time again. Every "her" in the dark night holds tight to hope and courage, cutting through thorns to run toward that glimmer of dawn.

title: Crimson Feather: Blaze
description: The dark night always teaches her desire, compelling her to confront the truth. The bird that shuns judgment inevitably withers in a foreign land. She says, "My friend, do not mourn. I will offer you my final song. My soul shall be the sun that lights your path."

title: Crimson Feather: Ember
description: Why does she long for wings? Her thoughts rise and float toward the past. Does she wish to touch the sky or become a bird set free? Yet, deep inside, a softer voice lingers. More than flight, she yearns to be like everyone else, to be noticed, to be cherished.

title: Crimson Feather: Icy
description: The bird that once left the nest, fearful of loneliness, now bears frost upon her feathers as the north wind carves away her weakness. Pain solidifies into new wing bones, and she silently surrenders to the sculpting of wind and snow.

title: Crimson Feather: Rebirth
description: The legends whisper in the wind, recounting how flames, reflected in the frozen mirror, catch a glimpse of their own image. In the final season abandoned by the world, the migratory birds discover the path for their journey.

title: Snowy Ballad
description: Who summons the snow at the end of the world, weaving pure white walls into silence? It's the queen of the iceborn mermaid, ruling with crownless majesty, her voice a solemn oath of protection. Yet eternity is but an echo of time, and destruction, a fleeting breath of despair. Still, the traveler's gentle gaze lingers, cradling the last glimmer of light in the vast, unyielding frost.

title: Snowy Ballad: Farewell
description: The wind asks nothing of the past, and the Stonetrees mark no passage of time. Side by side, their shadows move through the changing light. No matter how the world transforms, or how the wilderness stirs, they remain hand in hand, ever drifting toward the horizon.

title: Snowy Ballad: Flame
description: On the scorched earth, the snowbound realm has melted into a mirage, its purity consumed by the fierce flames, leaving even the gods in chaos. Her tears freeze into vows of cold ice, striving to shatter the chains of life and death. In this frozen world, they drift into an eternal slumber through the winter.

title: Snowy Ballad: Oath
description: The wingless ever-blazing bird longs for boundless flight. The iceborn mermaid, unable to cease her song, yearns for her shattered homeland to be restored. At the world's edge, these two souls brimming with desire meet, exchanging a vow, offering their only wish.

title: Snowy Ballad: Silken
ja_name: 雪原の叙事詩・絹の夢
description: At the edge of the world, she dreamed. In the dream, the snow had not yet melted, and she had not yet grown up. Her people draped her in gossamer, and time itself blurred... How wonderful, for in that moment, she was no longer alone.

title: Dance Till Dawn: Fireworks
ja_name: 夜明け前の躍動・小さな花火
description: The cries of victory soared with the jubilant song, charging into the night against a backdrop of blooming fireworks. The night tightened its tender embrace, whispering, "When you are happy, the stars will dance with you."

title: Florabound Promise: Blazing Heart
description: The third child longed to become the bravest hunter, so the fairy gave her a red fruit. But when the glory of strength blinded her, where would the heart that once vowed to protect all things finally fall?

title: Florabound Promise: Growth
description: The second child made a wish to understand the language of the forest, so green leaves and strands of hair were woven into a necklace around his neck. But when praise raised him as the embodiment of the harvest, could those listening ears still hear the forest's cries?

title: Florabound Promise: Prismatic Dream
description: "The wind is my breath, the grass my skirt. Fish swim through my body, and Behemoths are my kin. I remain ever the same, yet my face often changes." The riddle became the answer he had waited for all his life, and that answer had always been in his heart.

title: Florabound Promise: Pure Radiance
description: By the time tales of the fairy rode the wind to the Shroomlings' ears, they were already shrouded in terror. In the forest, they warned one another: "Never speak with the fairy! She would trample your will and toy with your feelings!"

title: Dawning Heartlight: Empty Cocoon
resonance: |description   = So be it, so be it. A fate with broken wings can only wait to freeze, cocooning itself in silence, yet never seeing the day it emerges.
description: So be it, so be it. A fate with broken wings can only wait to freeze, cocooning itself in silence, yet never seeing the day it emerges.

title: Dawning Heartlight: Falling Flame
resonance: |description   = That fire seeped through the cracks into her wing bones, and the bright wish she made as a child was finally tempered into a blade. If pain was sharp enough, could it stand in for the self that had long since blurred?
description: That fire seeped through the cracks into her wing bones, and the bright wish she made as a child was finally tempered into a blade. If pain was sharp enough, could it stand in for the self that had long since blurred?

title: Dawning Heartlight: Fledgling
resonance: |description   = The child did not yet know why all things withered and flourished, or why the birds had flown away. She simply lifted her face and wondered blankly: where were people meant to go, and who was she meant to become?
description: The child did not yet know why all things withered and flourished, or why the birds had flown away. She simply lifted her face and wondered blankly: where were people meant to go, and who was she meant to become?

title: Dawning Heartlight: Renewed Gleam
resonance: |description   = The god's daughter once saw a god's duties as where she belonged. When she stumbled to the end of fate, countless mirrors had finally peeled away, and she met herself again. In that moment, all dreams suddenly weighed less than a feather.
description: The god's daughter once saw a god's duties as where she belonged. When she stumbled to the end of fate, countless mirrors had finally peeled away, and she met herself again. In that moment, all dreams suddenly weighed less than a feather.

title: Hymn to Dusk: Aurum
description: It was an unparalleled golden age. The radiance of the Heart of the City shone over the Golden Court, and surging energy never ran dry. Yet the brighter the glory burned, the deeper and darker the shadows on its underside grew...

title: Hymn to Dusk: Dusted
description: A civilization once radiant vanished at the height of its glory. The city, fallen into slumber, was woven into legend. O traveler from afar, have you ever heard of the Sleeping Golden City?

title: Hymn to Dusk: Godfall
description: Even immortal gods may fall. Echeros had long grasped the Titan race's irredeemable tragedy and foresaw the end that was certain to come for him. Gods and mortals alike shall return to nothingness.

title: Hymn to Dusk: Honed Edge
description: A storm that blotted out the sky arose when the god lost control. Before the newly erected tombstones, a new thought took root in Asna's heart—could human strength stand equal to the gods?

title: White Night's Ballet: Awakening
resonance: |description   = The jeweled curtain wall reflected countless overlapping shadows, yet she still danced to the appointed rhythms. Until one turn, when she recognized herself among those layered reflections, a belated confusion suddenly stirred in her heart.
