description: The jeweled curtain wall reflected countless overlapping shadows, yet she still danced to the appointed rhythms. Until one turn, when she recognized herself among those layered reflections, a belated confusion suddenly stirred in her heart.

title: White Night's Ballet: First Glow
resonance: |description   = Flowers bloom for themselves, and streams run for themselves. At last, she danced for herself as well, and the shackles of the past could no longer hold her in place. Sunlight finally scattered the old shadows, and she ran toward the freedom of the wilderness.
description: Flowers bloom for themselves, and streams run for themselves. At last, she danced for herself as well, and the shackles of the past could no longer hold her in place. Sunlight finally scattered the old shadows, and she ran toward the freedom of the wilderness.

title: White Night's Ballet: Flamewake
resonance: |description   = She danced her final dance, bidding farewell to the self she had once been. Even if it cost her the power that had long sustained her, she would use her own willpower to write the final chapter of the dance offered to the throne.
description: She danced her final dance, bidding farewell to the self she had once been. Even if it cost her the power that had long sustained her, she would use her own willpower to write the final chapter of the dance offered to the throne.

title: White Night's Ballet: Undercurrent
resonance: |description   = She began to create deviations within her fixed course, letting each turn linger a moment longer and each step land at a different angle. It was the smallest and most dangerous rebellion. She had not yet broken free from the law of perpetual motion, but the desire to stop had already awakened within her.
description: She began to create deviations within her fixed course, letting each turn linger a moment longer and each step land at a different angle. It was the smallest and most dangerous rebellion. She had not yet broken free from the law of perpetual motion, but the desire to stop had already awakened within her.

title: Rippling Reverie: Ensemble
description: Yesterday is a warm remembrance, and tomorrow is an anticipated distance. When standing shoulder-to-shoulder with friends, the journey is filled with brilliant new sprouts breaking through the soil. Keep listening to unknown stories, keep taking the hands of future companions, and keep loving this land that's brimming with miracles.

title: Rippling Reverie: Nursery Rhyme
description: When stepping from innocence into maturity, the future becomes the tomorrow of the past. Yet, that sincerity has never truly left. That sorrow, laughter, and moment of tenderness have always been wrapped inside the pink candy wrapper called growing up, and kept gently in the depths of her heart.

title: Soundless Dawn
description: Those eyes, long since burdened with too much sorrow, were meant to see a different ending: herself clad in the outfit of the Witness, beneath the blessings and watchful gazes of her people, plucking the strings of her harp to guide countless souls toward the other shore. But life grants no ifs, and time cannot be reversed.

title: Soundless Dawn: Floral Melody
description: Souls are like flowers that wither and pass through rebirth, becoming new buds rising from the soil. Medael once believed this without doubt. She once fell into despair as well, until at last she looked back at the world and saw that unfading spring.

title: Soundless Dawn: Forest Echoes
description: In the long years of watching, the girl chosen as the witness refuses to remain silent as souls depart. She arrives with her instrument, letting its strings pierce the night. Dark garments conceal her form, while the wind-like melody lets wandering souls hear a long-forgotten echo on their final journey.

title: Soundless Dawn: New Morn
description: Do those souls who journey to the other shore sense a touch of coldness? Do they feel lonely, and thus fear that dark, frigid death? Until that day, golden flowers burst from the ground like a newborn dawn, lighting the path before them.
parts: Harmony of All Souls: New Morn

title: Soundless Dawn: Woven Light
description: A century ago, a stylist gathered the legendary golden miracle flowers and transformed them into ceremonial attire to guard the cycle of rebirth. From then on, every witness who wears it soothes the wandering dead with a gentle heart, carrying an ancient legacy forward through time.

title: Floral Rebirth: Awakening Hymn
description: When do the flowers awaken? When ripples rise again in the Cradle of Reincarnation and the newborn God of Reincarnation opens innocent eyes. The dragons return the teachings of the past like a flowing stream, and the swaying sea of flowers witnesses another inheritance of the mission.

title: Floral Rebirth: Emerald Reverie
description: When do the flowers sprout? At the moment the God of Reincarnation breathed a wisp of Their vast radiance into the world, the newborn dragons broke from their shells. Their sacred teachings were buried like seeds deep within those newborn souls; there, the mission of guidance took root, silently awaiting the hour of its bloom.

title: Floral Rebirth: Final Vow
description: When do the flowers wither? When the long watch exhausts the last of their strength, the dragons' scales lose their luster and their souls are soaked in impurity. They look back at the path the God of Reincarnation walked, and then follow it without hesitation, even if the road ahead is destined for extinction.

title: Floral Rebirth: Growth & Decay
description: When do the flowers become immortal? When the Parksolians sing the tales of the dragons by the campfire, when the towering dragon bones turn into rolling mountains, and when the immortal will flows through their blood. The death of the dragons is not a farewell; they have gained new life in another form.
parts: Echoes in the Wind: Growth & Decay

title: Guide of No Return: Commitment
description: Souls are at peace, and the orchids are in full bloom. It turns out that at the end of destiny lie infinite memories and love; even the boundary between life and death cannot erase a vow carved into the bone.

title: Guide of No Return: Fate
description: The dust has finally settled, and the silt has sunk to the depths. They have never been a mere spectator on the bank, but the river itself. The shimmering reflections of the past have grown old, yet the fresh, newborn currents will forever pour forth from the mountain peaks.

title: Guide of No Return: Tranquility
description: The biting winds of the mountains have faded, and the desolate, moonlit wilderness is nowhere to be seen. Instead, a brilliant sun, golden as wheat, illuminates the tranquil life breathing beneath the great trees. They stand beneath the Mothershroom, listening in silence to the alternative answer that life has written for itself.

title: Guide of No Return: Valediction
description: Morning clouds burn across the horizon as the twilight dragon bids Them farewell at dawn. Tears fall, not from the sorrow of parting, but from the weight of inheritance. Deep within the long night, there is more than just snowy solitude—there is the warmth of tomorrow's sun.

title: She Is Wildfire: Forest
ja_name: 彼女は不縛の炎・森林
description: She runs through shifting shadows and dappled light, leaping barefoot over brooks and climbing vines by hand. Her racing feet will never rest! Her free heart will know no fear! She belongs not to the paths of yesterday, but to every wild, sprawling tomorrow.

title: She Is Wildfire: Frontispiece
ja_name: 彼女は不縛の炎・扉頁
description: Have you ever seen a rainbow swirling in steam? Have you ever seen lightning take up residence in a crucible? In the palm of her hand, miracles leave a trail. In her arms, plants babble their first words. When she smiles, the laboratory bursts into bloom; when she smiles, all fairytales sprout.

title: She Is Wildfire: Journey
ja_name: 彼女は不縛の炎・周遊
description: She remembers that farewell, when the forest was still like an innocent child, dreaming of berries and fireflies. She is going to faraway lands; by the time she returns, she will be fully grown. She is going into the distance, and no matter how long it takes, the forest will remember.

title: She Is Wildfire: Waning Moon
ja_name: 彼女は不縛の炎・残月
description: In that strange, frozen wasteland of dreams, she forgot everything. Silver light pricked from her fingertips; her back arched into a crescent moon. Who am I? Am I still myself? The darkness did not answer, using only a deeper silence to wait for the moonlight to stitch together the silhouette of a wolf.

title: Dreamtime Bestowed: Blazing Heart
ja_name: 夢見る心のひと時・熾心
description: Was it the wish to rekindle a fallen spark, snuffed out before the rumors began? Was it an aching compassion for the spread of gloom? Or perhaps it was the eyes lit up by her songs that pushed her already unwavering resolve even further. She told herself: I will come back, unstoppable.

title: Dreamtime Bestowed: Bright Ending
ja_name: 夢見る心のひと時・終彩
description: The fairy tale gifted Roucoco a dream, and she, in return, offered the fairy tale an open ending. From that moment on, the story lingered on the far shore, while she remained on this one. The dream wrote itself between the pages, and she stepped back into her own life, laughing alongside the people she loved.

title: Dreamtime Bestowed: Hollow Rumor
ja_name: 夢見る心のひと時・幻言
description: Faced with a tide of rumors and malicious whispers, the young girl answered with unstoppable courage and irrefutable proof. Even when reality dealt her blow after blow, the memory of that proud figure taking a final bow was enough to warm Roucoco's heart once more.

title: Dreamtime Bestowed: Light Pursuer
ja_name: 夢見る心のひと時・巡光
description: A girl of remarkable talent set a dim world alight, with her unrestrained, radiant voice and her generous heart. Whenever the fairy tale reaches this chapter, Roucoco dreams that she, too, might one day soothe sorrow and bring light and hope to her fans through her performances.

title: Chroma's Mortal Heart: Echoes
ja_name: 人心を有す九色・遺音
description: What She kept in Her heart was a scroll of tales, a solitary city, and beings neither wholly real nor wholly illusory. Memories spread through Her spirit like ink in water, sometimes deepening, sometimes fading. Though years passed unceasingly, the past returned without warning, like a temple bell shattering sleep, like lingering mist coiling once more through the valleys.

title: Chroma's Mortal Heart: Parting
ja_name: 人心を有す九色・永別
description: Upon first glimpsing the fleeting glow of the human world, a quiet melancholy stirred—regret faint yet lingering, resentment soft yet unending. The mind could sense all directions, yet the body remained confined to one place. Such was the sorrow of jade: radiant and resplendent, yet forever apart. Though adorned with flowing light, She was not of the mortal world, and could not know its joys or griefs.

title: Chroma's Mortal Heart: Seared
ja_name: 人心を有す九色・焚心
description: Stone endured in darkness, without thought or sensation. Time stretched on endlessly. The joy of first awakening slowly faded; the scorch of sunlight went unfelt, the tenderness of moonlight unrecognized. Only the solitude of time endured. She heard a thousand murmured sufferings, yet could not reach them; questioned heaven and earth for the reason of birth, yet found no answer. Countless pains burned within, and loneliness was known in full.

title: Chroma's Mortal Heart: Wanxiang
ja_name: 人心を有す九色・万相
description: She once held only a single thought, believing the living warmth of Linlang to be the only vessel for salvation. Thus She poured forth Her jade essence, exhausted Her radiance, and reached beyond desolation. From emptiness, She sought to raise a city, shape its robes and crowns, and carve anew a vision of the "human world."

title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life: Benevolence
ja_name: 浮生を渡る万相・美丹心
description: Once sickly bones now slowly mend; once dimmed eyes recover their clear light. From the flesh grown full, one knows vitality has begun to flow; from the gaze rekindled, one recognizes the spirit's return. The revival of life, though spoken of in ten thousand words, still defies even a fraction of its truth.

title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life: Empathy
ja_name: 浮生を渡る万相・悲歓戯
evolution: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life: Lived World
description: Living in the world, to know one's own heart is easy; to step into another's life is hard. Without standing within the scene, how could one grasp the entanglements of mortal bonds, or the weight of causes mistaken and fate delayed? Look upon the stage: kings and ministers, scholars and beauties; laughter and tears, partings and reunions beneath shifting lights. In these rises and falls, might one glimpse the true currents of human feeling?

title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life: Integrity
ja_name: 浮生を渡る万相・誠実心
description: Observing this world, she came to understand that "human" was never merely skin or form. The script might grant the shape, but where did the spirit arise? Look to the stores: voices bustling, courtesies exchanged, a scene warm and alive. Somewhere within this ebb and flow, the true meaning of mortal life seemed to emerge; yet, like flowers seen through mist, it remained just beyond her grasp.

title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life: Lived World
ja_name: 浮生を渡る万相・人間界
description: The myriad patterns of mortal life were like scattered pearls, lost in the long river of years. Now gathered anew, their radiance returned to the world. Scrolls by the thousand were unfolded, sunken chapters salvaged from torn pages and broken fragments. Between the lines, the bustle of the streets stirred once more; laughter and sorrow alike found their voices again.

title: Forest Ripple: Glimmer
description: She buried her regrets in the moist soil, wandered through the tranquil Forest of Slumber, draped warm memories over her burgeoning fur, and stepped alone into the depths of the woods.

title: Forest Ripple: Glowlit
description: She wished to consume the gentle past like eating a ripe fruit, letting it melt within her, so she might live alongside the forest and sunlight, quietly growing into a tree, sharing her life story with the sky.

title: Forest Ripple: Mistlit
description: Since then, she had learned to cherish every sunset. Uncertain when parting might come, she savored the radiant glow while walking side by side with those she held dear.

title: Forest Ripple: Roaming
description: Her body stretched, life blossomed, and regrets faded. Longing condensed into the fleeting span of growth. Then, she swiftly ran to embrace the new season of life.

title: Behind Prayers: Bright Moon
ja_name: 秘せし祈りの調べ・明月
description: Illuminated by the moon and accompanied by whispers, she was the divine maiden who prayed for her people and followed their god's teachings. The cold stung, emptiness spread, and in the tower above, she devoted herself to her people, her sincerity unknown. From then on, the world would forget her joys and sorrows.

title: Behind Prayers: Green Woods
ja_name: 秘せし祈りの調べ・森翠
description: With her eyes closed and hands clasped, she was the divine maiden entrusted with hope, destined to bring back their god one day. Green shoots sprouted, trees flourished, and the ceaseless prayers from the tower at last became a miracle, descending through her lips.

title: Behind Prayers: Silent Ashes
ja_name: 秘せし祈りの調べ・静灰
description: Prayers twisted and dark currents surged, she was the divine maiden who tore through falsehoods, destined to ignite the flames of vengeance. The tower shattered, the kingdom fell, and no one heard the anguished cries of those struggling amid the ruins. From then on, the tower would no longer hold the divine maiden offering prayers.

title: Behind Prayers: Somber Nights
ja_name: 秘せし祈りの調べ・深闇
description: Golden light shimmered, wheat waves stretched endlessly, she was the divine maiden destined to bring back their god, to restore the eternal prosperity promised by the divine. Scars snaked across her skin, her black hair withered, yet no one noticed the face she offered to the god in the tower above. From then on, the world would forget her face.

title: Born Flawless: Caged Dream
description: There were countless long nights where only the moon was watching. In the cold, golden reflection, she experienced a dream of nothingness, again and again.

title: Born Flawless: Forest Song
description: From the silence, a girl was born. When her eyes were greeted with the first ray of sunlight, she felt lost, unsure of why she came to be, and unable to recall where she should go.

title: Born Flawless: Glowing Embers
description: From the ashes, a lie was born. No one knew it to be the ember of old flames. Even so, she tried to reforge the name of truth from the ashes.

title: Born Flawless: Mirrored Self
description: Facing the girl with the Heart of Infinity, she revealed her identity, her mark—her destiny.

title: Providence Immemorial: Cycle
description: Echeros once stood at the edge of oblivion, where death consumed glimmers of life like an abyss. The light of life kept pouring in like a flood, ever shining and never ending.

title: Providence Immemorial: Finality
description: Echeros was consumed by the wailing tides. Before the torrents of fate, Their anguish was no more powerful than mere ripples. All that was living was destined to return to nothingness.

title: Providence Immemorial: Prosperity
description: If the world had not fallen into silence, if the gods had never left, would the forest have remained green and prosperous to this day, fostering all life?

title: Providence Immemorial: Shackles
description: Echeros, who could not abide the clamor of the mortal world, resided in the serene forest. Through the silent passage of time, the lonely god was accompanied only by Their descendants, and Their creations.

title: Radiant Crown: Glimmer
description: When she ascended as the "sun," she finally realized the worth of past glimmers.

title: Echoed Dreams: Fated
ja_name: アリオーソの旧夢・再逢
description: As the silhouette stretched and laughter drifted further away, after today's farewell, who knows when they'll meet again? The final notes of the unfinished story fell softly at her feet, just a quiet echo of ever-growing longing.

title: Echoed Dreams: Future Tone
ja_name: アリオーソの旧夢・未来の声
description: Through countless days shared together, they dreamt of all that could be, planning the faraway stops of their future tour. She watched youthful clouds drift on the breeze, and the endless blue sky shone as brightly as her ideals.

title: Echoed Dreams: Rose Finale
ja_name: アリオーソの旧夢・最後のバラ
description: From within the flames, a voice seemed to sigh and ask, "Lorelei's brightest rose, why must you bloom alone on this stage, in this fire?" And she answered, "Because this is the final refrain of my life."

title: Echoed Dreams: Threaded Melody
ja_name: アリオーソの旧夢・人形の歌
description: A lost soul inscribed false incantations with an eternal vow. Her image and voice were sealed in this form, imprisoned in time's permanent bloom: trapped, unchanged, until the end of time.

title: Clouded Loong: Eye-Dotting
ja_name: 龍は雲墨に帰す・点睛
description: Danqing flows from the brush's tip, each year new strokes grace hopeful eyes. Though thousands echo past intent, none match first ink on fresh silk.

title: Clouded Loong: Misty Celadon
ja_name: 龍は雲墨に帰す・浅緑
description: White Loong lifts moon from water's face, yet lingers still, one step too late. Ripples shimmer cold and pale, their glow spares not the one astray. Where ink has dried and wells run bare, a lone scale's path returns in vain. The silk, untouched, remains unstained, while silver tears fall night by night.

title: Clouded Loong: Red Ribbons
ja_name: 龍は雲墨に帰す・紅綾
description: What is Yin Yuan in this world? Is it forgetting past vows, or being forever parted between heaven and earth? All threads of fate hang incomplete, and only weary hearts remain. If this tower of red silk can be burned as a fuse, can the heavens themselves be defied?

title: Clouded Loong: Spring Stream
ja_name: 龍は雲墨に帰す・春澗
description: With a single bow, It cradled a fallen child in a gleam of scales. After, moonlight gained warmth, and the mountain wind learned to pause. In the end, It chose to pursue the human world.

title: Forever Bond: Among Flora
ja_name: 共縁は夢魂に巡る・草間
description: Cold moon and warm sun wore down the passing time, until the homeland's fading blood settled into peaceful memory, and the cycles of grass and trees sang songs of joy. She witnessed the rise and fall of Yin Yuan, finding ordinary life in every painted scene.

title: Forever Bond: Farewell Prelude
ja_name: 共縁は夢魂に巡る・別序
description: Sitting opposite, gazing into her eyes during quiet games, they once shared countless eternal dreams. But like flowing water and falling flowers, life was full of long regrets. The girl spoke no comfort of reunion, only soft laughter, hiding her longing in a moonwhite Fortune Stick.

title: Forever Bond: Mortal Affairs
ja_name: 共縁は夢魂に巡る・世事
description: At the Yin Yuan Festival, laughter and joy caught the girl's bright gaze. She passed through bustling streets, and when the music ended, only the cool dusk remained. Knowing she must part, she hoped to ease her friend's sorrow with kind words before bidding farewell.

title: Forever Bond: Spirit Trail
ja_name: 共縁は夢魂に巡る・霊踪
description: The misty smoke faded away, leaving only pavilions and towers, with grass and trees swaying in the unchanging breeze. A pale pink nimble cat sat among the shaking willows, listening to the silent world. Until, wandering past all living things, she finally heard the vibrant pulse of life.

title: Tide of Tears: Amber Fire
ja_name: 涙影は潮に落ちて・橙火
description: "How do you control your scales when you're emotional? How do you read someone's expression while speaking? How do you..." Her friend didn't answer. She knew that her kind and genuine heart would surely be embraced by others.

title: Tide of Tears: Lament
ja_name: 涙影は潮に落ちて・挽歌
description: When war's flames swept across the land, the wheat fields sang a mournful song, soothing the grieving villages and bearing witness to the silent scorched earth. After many seasons, the wind would softly stir the fields again, and new seedlings would slowly ripen into gold.

title: Tide of Tears: Scales
ja_name: 涙影は潮に落ちて・落鱗
description: Glimmers of unshed tears lingered over the ruins. Those who wept hid their pain deep inside. With her scales, she rescued a spark of hope from the disaster, easing the sorrow and opening a new chapter.

title: Tide of Tears: Snow
ja_name: 涙影は潮に落ちて・氷雪
description: After traveling through countless towns and villages, the two rangers still held that snowy land in their hearts, where frost lay thick and cold winds whispered. Even beneath frozen soil, warm fruits could grow, quietly waiting through wind and snow.

title: Enchanted Encounter: Dreamtrail
ja_name: フェアリーノート・心跡
description: She once answered the call of her heart, eager to escape the cycle of apprenticeship. The final test of the dazzling fairy attire awaited in a distant land... This time, she is not alone. With companions by her side, she creates miracles alongside kindred spirits from another world.

title: Enchanted Encounter: Emerald Dream
ja_name: フェアリーノート・幻翠
description: The lush, dripping vines wove a flat green carpet, with dewdrops and sunlight dotting the earth. Not yet an official fairy, she wandered lost in the forest and accidentally stumbled upon a secret fairy tea party.

title: Enchanted Encounter: Gleam
ja_name: フェアリーノート・明光
description: The young girl fell into the abyss, but in her despair, a fairy lightly waved her wand, and a soft feather descended, lifting her up amidst a beam of clear light, dispelling the mist that clouded her dreams.

title: Enchanted Encounter: Snowcrest
ja_name: フェアリーノート・雪路
description: In the boundless world of silver and snow, a lone figure trudged through the frosty wind. After a long time, she finally caught a glimmer of light. As frost blossoms bloomed at her fingertips, a faint magic began to flow like the Dreamvale Spring for the first time.

title: Blooming Dreams: Blue Mist
description: When the first light of morning seeps through the mist of the forest, the young flower fairy awakens from a century-long slumber, about to begin her short adventure.

title: Crimson Rhapsody: Dreamlike
description: She sometimes wondered, perhaps if she could soften and make those fiery, aggressive colors gentle and cute, could people stop casting strange looks? But everyone knew that sugarcoating paper couldn't truly hide the bitterness of the medicine.

title: Crystal Poems: Spring Snow
description: In the fairytale "The Daughter of the Snow", the girl's hometown lies beneath a perpetual blanket of snow. The long, unyielding winter shrouds every hint of spring, leaving behind only the endless dance of fine snowflakes and the fleeting blush of rosy clouds to herald the season's arrival.

title: Dance Till Dawn: Star Melody
ja_name: 夜明け前の躍動・糠星
description: Unmoved by the peace of the distant shore, yet unafraid of the evil close at hand, countless boats sliced through the endless twilight. Under the starry sky, the eyes of those who went against the tide flickered, and the fading glow of fireworks lit up the dark rivers winding between the islands.

title: Stardust Flare: Dawn Mist
description: At the edge of the night, the morning star glimmered faintly, bearing witness to her quiet journey. Through the haze of longing and pursuit, tiny embers burned steadily, lighting the path toward the fireworks.

title: Timeless Melody: Lullaby
ja_name: クラシックの楽章・安歌
description: The bronze-colored clockwork came to a halt, the music fading as everything slipped into slumber. Only the moonlight and the potted plants on the windowsill stayed awake, keeping company with the solitary figure by the window.

title: Wings of Wishes: Gentle Dawn
ja_name: 羽ばたく願い事・柔光
description: As the first soft light of dawn breaks over the horizon, the giant paper crane begins its journey, carrying wishes from beneath the Great Wishtree toward the place where they are stored. This is the most beloved and familiar sight for the residents of Florawish.

title: Crimson Rhapsody: Delusion
ja_name: 緋い夜の狂想・儚い執念
description: The moment she fell into the Illusion Zone, the prelude to the carnival began. Scissors and needles were set, a clock ticking away, as abandoned dolls gathered around a table. On this intoxicating night, the feast of delusion unfolded eternally.

title: Crimson Rhapsody: Leafy
ja_name: 緋い夜の狂想・葉の手稿
description: From the first sight of the doll by the window, to finding it in the fields, and later witnessing its transformation into something brand new... the entire journey of encountering the Felispirit Sack was carefully recorded on manuscripts made from leaves.

title: Crimson Rhapsody: Past Dreams
ja_name: 緋い夜の狂想・往日の夢
description: Sometimes, she couldn't help but imagine the original form of the Felispirit Sack. In those days, its world was pure and flawless, and it was content to rest in the warm embrace of its owner. In its eyes, suffering was nothing more than a distant, obscure nightmare.

title: Timeless Melody: Rhapsody
ja_name: クラシックの楽章・狂想曲
description: The rotating core awakens the gentle hum of gears, bringing the sleeping melody to life once more. This final rhapsody is dedicated to the dream that lingers between day and night.

title: Timeless Melody: Symphony
ja_name: クラシックの楽章・交響曲
description: The soft click of turning gears sets the music box's first symphony in motion—a melody dedicated to the moon that has yet to fade.

title: Timeless Melody: Variations
ja_name: クラシックの楽章・変奏曲
description: In a sudden shift, the ethereal tune blazes into fiery intensity, igniting the night like a sea of crimson blossoms. This variation is meant for passionate dances and hearts that burn just as brightly.

title: Dance Till Dawn: Nightlight
ja_name: 夜明け前の躍動・小さな夜灯
description: One by one, the warm yellow night lights beckon to the earth. In the realm of fireworks, eternal fires always burn brightly, lighting the way for those who courageously forge ahead.

title: Stardust Flare: Blaze
ja_name: 夜を彩る光・灼熱の焔
description: Day after day, she yearned for the spark that might one day ignite in her palm. Her longing would soon break free, shedding its restraints to rise toward its fated meeting with the sky.

title: Stardust Flare: Eternal
ja_name: 夜を彩る光・永炎の灯
description: The dark night gifted her a pair of dimmed eyes, yet she longed to find a light that would burn eternal. Unable to summon flowers from the night sky, she instead gave her boundless and steadfast love. A small firework danced around her, warming her hopeful heart.

title: Stardust Flare: Golden
ja_name: 夜を彩る光・眩惑の金
description: The tide of fame and fortune surged toward her, but in the end, her choice mirrored the fireworks she cherished: shining brightly at its peak, then fading gracefully when the time came.

title: Nameless, Selfless: Azure Sky
description: The sky above the dome resembled the palace, equally high and equally changeable. A single rain would wash away the dust, along with the blood of the innocent.

title: Nameless, Selfless: Ember
description: The flames that once consumed her home had long been extinguished, leaving only ash-strewn ruins. Yet why did that scorching, piercing pain still clutch at her heart every night, forcing her to lift her gaze in search of a vague, empty destiny?

title: Nameless, Selfless: Long Night
description: For whom did she work? To whom should she pledge allegiance? Which flag should be torn, whose hearts shattered, and which lies preserved? Across what trail of blood should she advance?

title: Nameless, Selfless: Returning Soul
description: Throughout this journey, she was soaked in the entanglement of good and evil, witnessing the clashes of sword and steel. She had come filled with hatred, yet departed embracing a heart without regret.

title: Rainfall & Blossoms: Anticipation
ja_name: 雨落ちて、花ひらく・待ち人
description: One petal chased the sunlight along the path, never returning; another counted the morning dew in a dream. If parting is the inevitable taste of chasing dreams and growing up, at least they once shared the same blossom.

title: Rainfall & Blossoms: Budding
ja_name: 雨落ちて、花ひらく・未華
description: She dreamed a long dream: sunlight spilling from the sky, clouds drifting aimlessly, rain flowing gently along the river, milk and honey treasured in every home, and the wind carrying the fragrance of fine wine...

title: Rainfall & Blossoms: Farewell
ja_name: 雨落ちて、花ひらく・別れ
description: Due to the clear skies and bouquets in the picture book, the two sisters pushed open the doors of fate. The elder sister's eyes shone with distant starlight, while the younger guarded a dream woven from sunlight. The clouds still hung low, yet their carefree childhood had gone, never to return.

title: Rainfall & Blossoms: Flourish
cn_name: 如雨坠，如花开· 怒放
ja_name: 雨落ちて、花ひらく・繚乱
description: She leapt from the high tower into cloud and rainbow, her countless thoughts scattering like shattered rain on the wind. Passion, reluctance, even fear—she broke through the storm, and when she looked back, the tallest spire of Rain City was no more than a speck.

title: Wings of Wishes: Moonlit
ja_name: 羽ばたく願い事・月夜
description: Moonlight taps at the night's door, and countless paper cranes pause on the high platform of the Dream Warehouse, watching over the wishes and dreams of Florawish.

title: Wings of Wishes: Past
ja_name: 羽ばたく願い事・憧影
description: A Grand Crane takes off from the high platform of the Dream Warehouse, soaring over forest-covered ruins toward the bustling, peaceful Land of Wishes.

title: Wings of Wishes: Sunny
ja_name: 羽ばたく願い事・晴空
description: Countless wishes gather under gods' watch, paper cranes spreading their wings. In the span of time, these wishes turn to hope, stored in a vast space, awaiting the day a Faewish Sprite will carry them away.

title: Blooming Dreams: Glow
description: As she recalled the moment when she finally broke free from the forest's grasp, the author's furrowed brow smoothed out. The warmth of those cherished memories enveloped her, and the very first sunrise after her narrow escape was deeply etched in her memory.

title: Blooming Dreams: Phoenix
description: The author recounted the final chapter of the story: The unexpected blaze that ravaged the land forced the Flower Sprite to confront the devastating hand of fate for the very first time. In the end, amidst the ashes, hope sprung anew as the restored homeland flourished, with creatures cheering her on and blossoms crowning her in glory.

title: Blooming Dreams: Tides
description: The author's mind is forever etched with the memory of her childhood wanderings in the forest: the gnawing hunger after getting lost, the terror of stumbling upon the thieves' hideout, the heaviness in her legs during her escape... But those are the parts beyond the fairy tale.

title: Crystal Poems: Blazing
description: Flipping through the pages, the collection of poems introduces a new chapter. The girl, now saturated with the sweetness of spring's embrace, finds her yearning for warmth intensifying. Her eyes gleam with a fiery passion that refuses to dim, a testament to her unyielding desire for more.

title: Crystal Poems: Snow
description: "The girl reminisces about her homeland," as depicted in the prologue of The Daughter of Ice. She cherishes the memories of her own world, reliving the frigid nights of her homeland. Even though the winds howled and snow raged that night, it remains one of her most treasured memories.

title: Crystal Poems: Spring
description: In the second volume of The Daughter of Ice, the girl bids farewell to her homeland and embarks on a long journey. She travels far and wide, ultimately reaching a city-state where spring's sunshine embraces the land with an eternal warmth. Every step of hers on the foreign land is a testament to her adventurous spirit and anticipation.

title: Rippling Reverie: Waltz
description: The rainbow after the rain represents colors that refuse to bow down even after weathering a storm, and hues that remain bright even when walking through the dark. Courage and fearlessness build a magnificent long bridge, and at its end lie miracles, answers, and a bright future.

title: Slumber by Blossoms: Evenfall
description: His life was once as lush as a great tree, yet it eventually withered like a dried leaf. Still, He gently promised them a future—dawn would come at last, and with it, the flowers would bloom.

title: Slumber by Blossoms: Flourishing
description: Loss, it seems, is but a mark etched by growth. They had already fulfilled the expectations of the god. Following the memory of how they were once protected, the Lumies now watch over the Parksolians and this tide-swept Boneyard.

title: Slumber by Blossoms: Sunward
description: As that splash of pink appeared once more, long-dormant memories stirred. They gathered around her footsteps, lighting the path to the truth. For the sake of hope, they feared nothing and regretted nothing, even if they burned through their bodies and gave their final spark of radiance.

title: Slumber by Blossoms: Tidecall
description: The ancient sound of the tides once more washes over the Boneyard, and the Lumies can almost hear the sweep of dragon wings across the sky. They yearn for that grand journey of the past—for the majestic sights that will never be seen again.

title: Blossoming Stars: Butterfly
description: The Starlit Breath believed it was lost in a magnificent daydream. Yet the butterfly, lingering patiently, silently whispered that, though she seemed insignificant, she was the most beautiful flower in its eyes.

title: Fairytale Swan: Vow
description: A soul untainted by dust asked the gods, "What is love?" Countless feathers suddenly fell, pushing her into a grand illusion. In the unknown purity, she could only hold onto the promise of the gods, having echoes as the answer.

title: Flutter Storm: Withered Song
ja_name: 孤島の蝶の羽ばたき・枯詠
description: The lonely butterfly will always age in the desolate wind, endlessly devouring solitude. The seasons shift, bringing both decay and growth, yet the butterfly girl, forever alone, ponders this as she watches.

title: Whispers of Waves: Falling Twilight
ja_name: 波間のささやき・残照
description: The old sailor once witnessed the scene at sunset: the eighteen-year-old sailor scooping up the fiery gold from the tips of the waves with an iron bucket, while the fifty-year-old sailor captured the lingering glow of the mast's reflection in his wrinkles. In the folds of the surging waves, everyone could gather their own dusk.
parts: Kiss of the Waves: Falling Twilight

title: Dance Till Dawn: Boat
ja_name: 夜明け前の躍動・小さな石舟
description: Plant a firework in the water, and it will emit a silent call. The boiling depths of the lake will gently raise the pebble boat. Listen closely, for it tells the story of a miracle known as Vespio.

title: Blossoming Stars: Dreamfall
description: In her autobiography, she recalls being immersed in a splendid dream. In this dream, spotlights hailed her as the sole protagonist. She was fully aware it was merely a captivating illusion, yet the allure of the dream was irresistibly sweet, trapping her as she roamed within, reluctant to awaken.

title: Blossoming Stars: Radiance
description: From standing at the edge of the stage to stepping into its center, she devoted a full decade. When myriad lights finally converged solely upon her, she had already become the unrivaled protagonist.

title: Blossoming Stars: Starlight
description: She understood that not everyone is the protagonist of the story; supporting roles are equally important. Like the dazzling lights in the night sky, they originate not only from the radiant big stars but also from countless twinkling small stars. Whether bright or dim, together they form this magnificent starry sky.

title: Fairytale Swan: Dream
description: The pristine moonlight accentuates the girl's dance with even more flawless grace. She responds to the enchanting calls by spinning but hesitates when the violin plays. Is it true or illusion? Perhaps, not any more after tonight.

title: Fairytale Swan: Mystfire
description: The lights adorn dream's borders. As the clock dispels illusions, why does the violin's tune intensify? Unable to grasp love's true essence, her soul faces flames, transforming white feathers to ashes.

title: Fairytale Swan: Truth
description: The enigmatic spell falls short in describing the mystery of love. The answer she seeks is in the eyes of her lover. Reflected in the eyes is neither the backdrop of the night sky with its myriad stars, nor the illusion adorned with feathers. There, only her silhouette resides.

title: Flutter Storm: Dream Chant
ja_name: 孤島の蝶の羽ばたき・夢吟の歌
description: Countless days and nights have passed, and the story of the butterfly and the desolate island has long been lost. Even the witnesses from that time are now in their twilight years. As the Queen prepares to close her eyes for the final time, the familiar dream seems to unfold in front of her once again.

title: Flutter Storm: Fire Song
ja_name: 孤島の蝶の羽ばたき・火焔の歌
description: The lonely girl finds no one to confide in. As butterflies flutter all around, a gentle breeze caresses her dress. The breeze travels across vast seas, eventually transforming into a storm that shatters everything at the end of its journey.

title: Flutter Storm: Forest Song
ja_name: 孤島の蝶の羽ばたき・花鳥の歌
description: Over those long years, a dense forest grew on the desolate island, and the frail figure with wings on her back fell into slumber within the sea of green blanketing the sky. Occasionally, the wind swept through the forest, echoing the flutter of wings.

title: Whispers of Waves: Echoes
ja_name: 波間のささやき・鼓動
description: As the old sailor recounts his encounters with her, his face betrays a hint of sadness mingled with nostalgia. It was the dawn of their tale, when he was but a novice sailor, often swaying unsteadily on the rocking deck, legs trembling beneath him.

title: Whispers of Waves: Forest
ja_name: 波間のささやき・森跡
description: "For any sailor with dreams of conquering the ocean depths, that treasure holds the key." The old sailor reminisces, his voice filled with the captain's fiery encouragement. "Grab your weapons, pack your rations, and fuel your resolve, young ones. Set sail and uncover that hidden treasure!"

title: Whispers of Waves: Phantom
ja_name: 波間のささやき・幽災
description: As the raging storm shattered ships and summoned the specter of death upon the waves, this sailor defied the odds and returned home a living legend. But he declared that he would leave the deck behind, swearing never to embark on another journey far from shore.

title: Silvergale's Aria: Dark Shadow
ja_name: 詠嘆の銀小夜啼・暗影
description: It was a romantic wish, like the dark currents beneath a deep pool, wrapped in honey and fine sand. He bent down to listen, and from the depths, the lover's call echoed. Finally, transformed into a Silvergale perched upon a branch, he prepared to sing a song for his beloved.
parts: Song of the Silvergale: Dark Shadow

title: Wishful Aurosa: Misty Dream
description: In the early morning, mist slowly spreads, and the Aurosa, not yet kissed by the grand radiance, quietly awakens in the faint light. It feels as though wishes are being born—still hazy and blurred—but still radiating a warm, soft glow.

title: Silvergale's Aria: Farewell
ja_name: 詠嘆の銀小夜啼・別れの時
description: In a final, searing moment of longing, He holds His beloved close, hoping for a last kiss. At the crossroads of destiny where wishes and love meet, all He can give is this single kiss.

title: Silvergale's Aria: Melody
ja_name: 詠嘆の銀小夜啼・変化の歌
description: In the stillness of the valley, the Silvergale chases a distant white figure with all His heart. His song resonates with a wish-turned-love, echoing endless devotion.

title: Silvergale's Aria: Tears
ja_name: 詠嘆の銀小夜啼・涙の跡
description: The moonlight softly graces the Silvergale's wings, bringing a gentle warmth to His wounded heart. Amid nightfall's shadows, cries and regrets layer in silence, hiding untold sorrows.

title: Wishful Aurosa: Blooming
description: Nestled among the lush foliage of the Millewish Tree, the tenderest leaves nurture the earliest whispers of Faewish Sprites. When the Aurosa blooms, these Faewish Sprites awaken from their slumber, spreading the divine power of wishes throughout the land once again.

title: Wishful Aurosa: Daybreak
description: In the shadow of the Grand Millewish Tree, the Aurosa, struggling to bloom, seems to be murmuring in suppressed tones, whispering tales of the sinister plots that lurk in the shadows.

title: Wishful Aurosa: Shadow
description: Before the dawn broke, unprecedented darkness enveloped the world, where gods and mortals alike sang a sorrowful ode to courage. Amidst that eternal night, are the radiant Aurosa blooms also weeping for someone?

title: Sea of Stars: Aurora
description: The magnificent auroras shimmered across the vast sky, and the birth of the universe was but an accident. However, within that accident, countless beautiful miracles collided. Civilizations fell and were reborn, but only beauty and love carried an eternal definition.

title: Sea of Stars: Infinity
description: Stars collapsed into black holes, shattered into rivers of light, and hope vanished in flames. The girl stood amidst the infinite Sea of Stars, gazing at the final, lonely nebula. The universe had shown her both its vastness and its emptiness—yet it also gave her the courage to face the unknown without fear.

title: Sea of Stars: Morning Star
description: The starry night listened to her wishes, gently responding in kind. The girl reached out her hand to the sky, and the ever-glowing starlight condensed in her palm.

title: Sea of Stars: Reverie
description: The boundless Sea of Stars wove infinite dreams around her, with the hem of her dress spinning an eternal celestial story. The young girl held fast to the starlight of hope, and no matter how treacherous the road ahead, she would press forward, driven toward the next unwritten adventure.

title: Threads of Reunion: Feast
description: During the agreed-upon reunion in the flourishing era, an unparalleled ball awaits. All creatures hold invitations, awaiting dance partners, exploring steps, finding their places. Before the music plays, everything is unknown.

title: Mechanical Demonstration: Renewal
description: Its gaze no longer turned to the cold chessboard, but to the breeze passing through the gears, the newly blooming flower in the corner, and every chance encounter in life.

title: Mechanical Demonstration: Variation
description: It lay forgotten in the ruins of the Golden Court, silently watching the world's rigid course until the chessboard was stirred by carefree, nimble steps, and it met the gaze of a vitality beyond the rules.
parts: Moving the Pieces in Silence: Variation

title: Curtains & Stars: Bloom
description: The curtain rose, spilling light over her trembling shoulders. Taking a deep breath, she danced with the soul of her role, her lines unfolding like wings. Applause surged like a tide as she lightly turned from the story, leaving only the soft pull of her heartbeat in her chest.

title: Curtains & Stars: Linger
description: After the curtain had fallen, she continued performing alone in the empty street, the moonlight her stage and the stars her companions, spinning and spinning. At that moment, she realized this love belonged to her soul. She bowed to the world, both a curtain call and a beginning.

title: Blooming Brocade: Departure
description: Time flew by, and the girl who once chased Ambirds had grown. The big tree before the house burst with fresh green leaves, while blooming flowers trailed down the windows. With a bag on her back, she prepared to depart on a journey of learning.

title: Blooming Brocade: Old Tales
description: The evening breeze swept across the table, stirring fallen petals and turning the pages just right to reveal the story of the little girl and the flowers.

title: Heartlake Ripples: Nightfall
description: Daylight faded into the depths of night, starlight tucked away with rain in the lake's ripples. Along the journey, brief showers fell, and her drifting thoughts sang gently through the dark, ripening into fragile fruit.

title: Dream in Glimpses: Vesper
description: Rectangular silhouettes intersect, veiling the faint contours of the horizon. Under the night's embrace, power lines extend in slender strokes, converging at the tip of her pen.

title: Forest's Fluttering: Autumn
ja_name: 森の蝶との戯れ・深秋
description: As all things wither, the entomologist's observations continue. Falling autumn leaves, curled-up insects, the steady growth of humus... How many secrets lie hidden in this quiet season?

title: Froggy Fashion: Refreshing
ja_name: カエルトレンド・心染
description: Clad in waterproof gear and boots, she steps into the rain, allowing the water to wash away her worries and fatigue. The world is renewed by the croaky chorus of Croakers, becoming light and fresh once more.

title: Graceful Elegance: Forest Silhouettes
description: After etiquette class, the little princess sinks into the soft embrace of her fluffy duvet. Just as sleep begins to settle in, her eyes are irresistibly drawn to the flickering fireflies dancing in the forest outside the window. In that fleeting moment, a bold thought takes root in her mind.

title: Graceful Elegance: Poised
description: As time wore on, the princess shed her youthful innocence and naivety. Having completed her etiquette studies, she emerged as a true graceful lady of the royal court.

title: Heartlake Ripples: Rainbow
description: As the last drop of rain falls, the sky transforms its hues, reflecting a peculiar glow upon the lake's surface. In the quiet moment, emotions shifted. The babbling stream led to the journey's beginning, and the seeds of thoughts sown would surely bear shining fruit.

title: Moment Capturer: Dusk
description: The evening clouds are her favorite new scenery. With a snap, the lens in her hand captures the shifting colors with perfect precision.

title: Moonlight Oath: Scarlet Tears
description: Memories spread recklessly within the heart, like an oath etched in cold stone beneath the blade's unforgiving edge. The vibrant ideals once born of love are now tainted with blood. Though a longing stirs to cross the hills of time and return to the past, the faces we once knew are no longer those of the youth we remember.

title: Radiant Night: Nocturne
description: As the last notes of the banquet's closing melody fade, she steps gracefully onto a path woven from starlight and night. Bathed in the moon's flowing song, her presence takes with it the brilliance of the evening's constellations.

title: Timeless Echo: Faraway
ja_name: 吟じられる古夢・遠方
description: A young girl crosses the vast ocean, starting a new life alone in a foreign land. She knows that only the items in her suitcase still carry the familiar scent of home. As she gently opens it, her homeland quietly unfurls within her heart.

title: Dream in Glimpses: Sweetness
description: A cozy coffee shop with a sweet aroma can be the perfect place for inspiration: from noon till sunset, shadows shift, and her pen flows, filling every blank page with designs.

title: Radiant Night: Forest
description: The moonlight filters through the gaps in the dense forest, scattering dappled radiance. The shimmering stars dance with the flowing hem of a dress, weaving a dreamlike and resplendent night.

title: Dancing in Frost: Dream Fulfilled
ja_name: 雪霜を抱きしめて・成就
description: She stood poised at center rink as a thousand lights converged. In the breath before the music began, she seemed to glimpse a small figure in a wheelchair, crossing time to watch—eyes bright, fixed on the person she had become.

title: Dancing in Frost: New Life
ja_name: 雪霜を抱きしめて・新生
description: Seated quietly in her wheelchair, she gazed at the figure gliding over the ice—freedom surging in her veins yet still out of reach, and a gown seemingly woven of ice and snow.

title: Forest's Fluttering: Starry
ja_name: 森の蝶との戯れ・星彩
description: As a child, they stumbled upon a Pearl Wings perched on the windowsill, its wings shimmering like a tiny starry sky under the moonlight. Captivated by this tiny dreamscape, they grew up to become an entomologist.

title: Froggy Fashion: Night
ja_name: カエルトレンド・守夜
description: In Florawish, the glow of the perpetual streetlights and the warm light of the mayor's residence are as familiar as the night sky. To pay the utmost respect to those heroic Croakers who keep our power system running smoothly, the award-winning designer has introduced a surprise exclusive edition.

title: Moment Capturer: Bloom
description: The chirping of insects at night chased away slumber, as the twinkling stars beckoned her on a quest. A faint fragrance wafted through the darkness, deeply captivating the girl's heart.

title: Moonlight Oath: Woods
description: Deep within the vast expanse of the forest, a lingering sigh echoes—as promises shatter and gods fade into memory, only the gentle whispers of new life comfort the land once bathed in the moonlight's glow.

title: Timeless Echo: Way Home
ja_name: 吟じられる古夢・帰路
description: After a long journey across the seas, she returns to her distant homeland. The echoes of old times softly call to her, but do the memories still match the scenes she left behind?

title: Cloudbreak Stitches: Landwoven
description: The flowering vine lived out its entire life upon the lapel, and the garment gained the colors of all four seasons. It was fresh green, deep crimson, and the silent snow white. The little tailor smiled as she put away her needle. This living garment was the most beautiful time she had sewn into the mortal world.

title: Cloudbreak Stitches: Spring Hills
description: She had grown old, so old that her breathing was like the wind in a valley, so old that she could no longer journey far and wide. She wanted to give the little tailor an everlasting home, one with flowering vines for a roof and embraces for walls. It would be a home where, once she moved in, she would never have to move away again.

title: Dawn's Melody: Morningtide
description: Gazing at her reflection of her dreams, she listened to echoes of the past. A childhood melody touched her longing, leading her to play the song of sunrise and bring a warm, radiant dawn that swept away the uncertain night.

title: Dawn's Melody: Splendor
description: The mournful strings came to an end, and clear notes opened a new chapter. The hidden sun shook off the shadows of the past and leapt out of the night, while flowers bloomed in the brilliant dawn. Dear listeners, please prick up your ears and hear her song.

title: Origin of Machinery: New Story
description: In the little tavern, the food delivery device that had long stood idle once carried delicacies and laughter at every dawn and dusk. The former masters of this city are no more, yet the same laughter rings out once again...

title: Origin of Machinery: Past Shadows
description: The once glorious Titans have long since vanished into the river of time, yet the machines they forged still run according to laws written a thousand years ago, cycling endlessly without rest.

title: Timeless Dreamwings: Dawn
description: The butterfly's perfection was an inborn gift. The moth's courage was an answer forged from imperfection. Her hem was tainted with mud, and her wings were covered in scars. Yet her eyes had never been so clear. She had come to understand the meaning of life.

title: Timeless Dreamwings: Dream Swamp
description: For whom is your beauty? Only for a bloom that withers silently after blossoming once? If wings are merely decorative, they are inferior to fins; if life cannot bear weight, it is inferior to ants. O night butterfly, could pride itself be nothing more than a fragile outer garment?
parts: A Touch of Eternity: Dream Swamp

title: Dream's Silhouette: In Bloom
ja_name: ドレスと夢の影・花季
description: With a light twirl, a star escapes the sleeve of the galaxy, and the gem falling from the hem accidentally strikes an unknown destiny. Wait no longer, hesitate no more—run toward the one you love beneath tonight's shimmering moonlight.
parts: Dreams in the Hem: In Bloom

title: Dream's Silhouette: Youthful Years
ja_name: ドレスと夢の影・年華
description: She took off her reading glasses and tucked the needle and thread she had used for half a lifetime into an old drawer. The formal gowns still hanging quietly in the shop were like unsent love letters. Some were sweet, some solemn, but all held a gentle silence, accompanying each person as they found their own path into the future.

title: Distant Stars: Brilliance
description: In the morning light, the child dances with the breeze and falling leaves, his innocent movements carrying the primal rhythm of nature. She stands quietly, watching this unpolished dance—and in that moment, she glimpses the truest language of the dance.

title: Distant Stars: Wilds
description: She gently closes her eyes, forgetting all techniques and allowing herself to sink into the rhythm of a falling leaf or a wisp of breeze. In every light leap and turn, she completes a dialogue with nature.

title: Tonight's Wind and Moon: Unfettered
description: With weary wings, she settles within the tiered forests as the dawn light reflects across a thousand peaks. Only by letting go of her obsessions does she truly grasp the boundless vastness of heaven and earth. She offers her final dance to the mountain breeze; having found her true resting place, she is finally free to wander without restraint.

title: Tonight's Wind and Moon: Wistfulness
description: The flowing light purls away, a stream that cannot be chased; the soulmate of yesterday is nowhere to be found. The hazy moonlight of that hour was, after all, nothing but a phantom dream of the mortal world.
parts: The World as a Score: Wistfulness

title: Daughter of the Kingdom: Eternal Light
description: Freedom, freedom, please hear her proclamation. She gave her all to let the song of resistance ring through the kingdom. She ignited the throne, burning away the smoke and the fires of war. Thereafter, the long night birthed the first dawn, and freedom echoed across the land.

title: Daughter of the Kingdom: Night Traverse
description: I will not forget, I will not go numb, I do not want the princess in the story, crowned in a land of war. I want to light the lamps, I want to steal the fire, I want my heart to stay in tomorrow, to nourish the saplings that will one day scrape the sky.

title: Pulse of the Desert: Expanse
description: She stood amid the vast desert, like a traveler between eternity and infinity, seeking to understand how life, both singular and enduring, drifted, transformed, vanished, and finally became the landscape before her.

title: Pulse of the Desert: Night
description: Rushing waters quenched the endless heat. Amidst ceaseless searching, she paused at last, gazing toward possibilities beyond the verdant green. She carefully sketched the contours of every wall, and slowly, everything there began to take shape before her eyes.
parts: By the River of Sand: Night

title: Forgotten Songs: Cold Frost
description: Cold frost muffled the echoes at the heart of the forest, letting old ruins rest in peace. Even though time had changed, those tales would sound out once again when snow fell, reminding visitors that the past had never truly vanished.

title: Forgotten Songs: New Bud
description: The old leaves had gone cold, but new saplings had already broken through the soil. Old glories had fallen silent, but new greens had inherited their undying resolve. The forest still stood, silently watching a new cycle of verdant vitality.

title: Melody Bloom: Chasing Light
description: Memories of Wishfield adventures remain as vivid as ever, recounting celebrations of new life and tears of sorrow. Every hardship was a trial of growth, every moment a testament to the power of friendship. May all the blessings gathered along the way brighten the path ahead.

title: Melody Bloom: Meeting of Stars
description: Every meeting is a boon of fate, every star a bearer of infinite hope. The Seer walks, leading a sea of stars that shines forever, much like the determination in the young girl's eyes.
parts: New Old Tale: Meeting of Stars

title: Purifying Wind: Dark Night
ja_name: かの風に捧げる舞・蒼夜
description: As night quietly fell, the earth slowly drifted into a deep slumber. The purifying arrow zoomed across the deep darkness, noiseless and traceless, aiming to reawaken the slumbering hope and bring the long-awaited dawn.

title: Purifying Wind: Deepening Dusk
ja_name: かの風に捧げる舞・沈暮
description: The sun set, the wind slowed, and the forest basked in the afterglow. A purifying arrow pierced the orange haze, silently hurtling toward its destination to uncover an answer hidden far away.

title: Sunflower Chronicle: Forest Dawn
description: What was once home lay in ruins. The land sat in silence, devoid of life. But people hadn't lost faith in the eventual awakening of the gods that would bring sunlight and colors back to the forest.
parts: Call of the Wind: Forest Dawn

title: Sunflower Chronicle: Full Bloom
description: The envoy walked alone through the night, until darkness swallowed them whole. Yet as life ebbed away, the hope within their heart blazed on, revealing a future where flowers blossomed across the once desolate land.

title: Blossoming Future: Heart Voice
description: The jubilant performance occasionally paused, while the quiet spotlight flowed like a breathing ocean, as the singer and audience shared a precious moment of calm together.

title: Blossoming Future: Stellar
description: The dazzling aurora tore the night sky open with shimmering gaps, and the girl's song echoed like the Milky Way, descending softly into the mortal realm.

title: Cheering Heartbeat: Soundwave
ja_name: 応援のハートビート・音波
description: Before her stage debut, she'd often imagined shedding the role of "fan" to become an idol. But when she finally saw herself beneath the radiant lights, so small, yet shining so brilliantly, she made a choice: to cheer for herself for the rest of her life.

title: Cheering Heartbeat: Star Echo
ja_name: 応援のハートビート・星連
description: She was a shooting star streaking across the sky, awakening hidden stars along the distant cape in quiet resonance. The "Cheer Dance" reflected countless shimmering universes in everyone, each glowing with its own brilliant light.

title: Endless Longing: Dreambound
description: Who knows people's thoughts? Who knows people's dreams? Let me send a branch of longing, as the flowers of the old garden bloom late.

title: Fiery Glow: Lush
description: Night's solitude faded beneath the dazzling fireworks, their splendor the only prelude to a grand tour. The pyrotechnic held their breath, crafting each burst to adorn the sky with a fresh bloom from the verdant wilds.

title: From the Depth: Oracle
ja_name: 深海より来たる・戒言
description: The story of the blind girl spread by word of mouth. Some called her a prophet, others a guide, or even a descendant of the divine. They wondered how clouded eyes could perceive tangled destinies, never knowing she had already seen the world through the sea.

title: From the Depth: Silenced
ja_name: 深海より来たる・終寂
description: A passerby once asked, "Blind girl who guards the sea, where does your own fate lead?" She gave no answer, only knowing that until the final moment arrived, all she could do was wait.

title: Gilded Memories: Flourishing
description: Even in the strictest days of childhood, there was always a comforting shade of green. It was the deer that tugged at the girl's dreams, guiding them through rainy seasons and into years lush with life.

title: Gilded Memories: Wandering
description: "Girl who grew up on my back, what more can I give you? As I grow old and gray, you're just beginning to shine. If there's one last thing I can do, it's to help you chase the dream you held as a child."

title: Starlit Celebration: Sublime Intent
description: The dazzling starlit sky bore witness to countless miracles, awaiting the glow they would one day radiate across the world. On one special day, the shimmering wishes intertwined, weaving a surprise for a little birthday star.

title: Balloon Trip
description: The time has come for that joyous holiday when one can play to their heart's content. It's time to dust off the balloons from childhood, fill them with air, and take them out for a stroll down the street!

title: Balloon Trip: Donut
ja_name: バルーン漫遊記・輪菓
description: She placed the round dough into the oven. "Ding!" The sweet aroma slowly filled the kitchen. Turning around, she discovered a balloon party set up by her loving parents.

title: Balloon Trip: Sour Candy
ja_name: バルーン漫遊記・爽飴
description: Stepping into the ivy-covered, balloon-adorned candy workshop, she felt as if she had fallen into a green whirlpool. The old factory owner picked a candy ball from the jar and handed it to her, saying, "Careful, this sour candy will make your cheeks tingle."

title: Adventure Ride: Shadow Chaser
description: The headlights sliced through the darkness ahead, gravel rattling beneath the tires, as the cowgirl's swift motorcycle raced to match the rhythmic beat of the Bullquet's hooves. And so, another chase was set in motion.

title: Art of Tailoring: Dream Shaper
ja_name: テーラリングアート・夢裁
description: The deep night embraces all—eccentric pairings, unconventional designs, and even misunderstood thoughts and musings, each finding its place in the vast expanse!

title: Dreamy Glimmer: Ripples
description: That deep water held all silence and echoes, yet it was nothing more than the briefest, gentlest ripple within the dazzling light.

title: Enchanted Writing: Luminous Night
description: Once more, she awakens beneath the silvery-white glow of the moon. The lingering joy of dancing in her dreams sets her thoughts in motion. She picks up her pen, letting her emotions flow as she recounts the moonlit ball...

title: Enduring Bond: Reunion
description: As midnight blends with the shadows, the moment of invitation arrives quietly. Moonlight witnesses the confrontation between the Guardian and the mysterious figure beneath the night sky. Amidst the announcement of masks and smoke, a decade-long promise of reunion unfolds.

title: Flowing Colors: Wonderland
ja_name: 筆先に漂う奇彩・奇境
description: The tip of the brush leaped with brilliant light, and fantastical dreams took shape on the canvas, emerging into reality one by one.

title: Honey Hunt: Green Fruit
description: Warm winds whisper as the tree bends under the weight of its green fruit. Swarms of bees flit around Mila, their wings stirring the fragrance of the still-green fruit. Strangely, though they nibble on what remains unripe, their tongues already taste its sweetness.

title: Honey Hunt: Nectar
description: Season after season, guided by the gentle hum of Foodie Bees, she uncovered the secret of sweetness, nurturing fruits as rich and golden as honey. Over time, the people honored her, bestowing upon her the cherished title of "Foodie Mila," in tribute to her dearest companion.

title: Pastoral Dance: Forest Path
ja_name: ふわふわ花踊り・森旅
description: With a cheerful step, she rings the bell in her hand, and the Florist Sheep bounces happily behind her. Just ahead, the picnic cottage stands ready.

title: Rippling Serenity: Sunset
description: The setting sun drapes a veil of gauze over the silent valley, and the butterflies and birds fall still. The sound of fish leaping disturbs the closing melody, while a fishing rod, illuminated with twilight hues, stretches all the way into the sky, shifting between day and night in an ever-changing dance.

title: Scaly Dream: Insects Awakening
description: In the land where the Loong coils, dew scatters, and life stirs anew. Tender buds and blossoms emerge, quietly nestled within the unchanging world, untouched by time.

title: Shark Mirage: Sand Waves
ja_name: 潮汐のサメの影・砂波
description: In the endless desert, a sacred land endures for those who ride the waves. To them, the desert is merely another ocean waiting to be conquered.

title: Spectral Mist: Scarlet Moon
description: It is said that when the silver-white full moon turns scarlet, the barren ruins will stir to life. As the ancient melody of the instrument fills the air, shadowy figures blur and dance with haunting grace—ushering in the grandest moment of the legendary ball.

title: Springbloom Enchantment: Dreamwhisper
ja_name: 花泉の幻想世界・夢語
description: In the stillness of night, the Springbloom slip into a deep, untroubled sleep. From the depths of a dream-filled realm, illusions dance to a hidden rhythm, and a quiet order begins to unfold. Can you hear its whispers? The flowers, blooming in their quiet way, are dreaming ancient, forgotten dreams.

title: Springbloom Enchantment: Serenity
ja_name: 花泉の幻想世界・無憂
description: Looking back on the endless growth, laughter and joy have woven hope into the new Springblooms. Within each petal lies the promise of tomorrow, as the harmonious symphony of life unfolds across tranquil waters.

title: Starfall Radiance: Dreamy Night
ja_name: 煌めく流星の刻・夢夜
description: The meteors that lit up the earth once illuminated countless dreams, just as they shone upon the past, present, and future.

title: Whispers of Bliss: Brilliant Bloom
description: Delicate petals of soft blooms gather on the canvas, forming a warm golden sea of flowers. The painter and the young girl stand side by side, each holding a brush, weaving their figures into the heart of the floral canvas.

title: Art of Tailoring: Scarlet
ja_name: テーラリングアート・赤いハサミ
description: The red moon rested upon the branch as the tailor twirled and danced. With the surging rhythm of the carnival, her movements grew ever more untamed—each spin and leap exuding an irresistible allure, drawing the attention of every Faewish Sprite.

title: Enchanted Writing: Starlight
description: She had once spent countless nights lost in her dreams, writing the stories that flowed from them. But tonight, she finally had the chance to turn the melody she had danced to in her dreams into real steps beneath her feet. Under the starlight, she would become the star of the stage...

title: Pastoral Dance: Snow
ja_name: ふわふわ花踊り・雪の絨毯
description: After the revelry, would the quiet of everyday life take over? Yet, on another day, amidst the biting cold and snow, they would dance again. Snowflakes gently drifted, their footsteps light, and with each soft jingle of the shepherdess's bell, every day became one worth dancing through.

title: Adventure Ride: Fantasy
description: In her deepest dreams, she and the Bullquet chase and play, their laughter rippling through every corner of the night.

title: Spectral Mist: Dawn
ja_name: 霧に漂う幻霊・夜明け
description: Feel the gentle caress of the morning's first light, witness the brilliance of each glowing cloud—each moment a quiet farewell, slipping away from the grand ball at dawn.

title: Endless Longing: Ethereal
description: Thoughts adrift, dreams adrift. Leave behind the clamor, let it shift. Songs send clouds to eastern rift.

title: Enduring Bond: Memories
description: A friend from afar returns with a ten-year promise, and suddenly, the night feels brighter, the stars warmer. By the fire, they share old stories, hoping their friendship burns as warmly and endlessly as the flames before them.

title: Fiery Glow: Wonder
ja_name: 燦燦たる焔光・不思議な夜
description: How many shows has the Fireworks Designer put on by now? Oh, never mind—it doesn't matter! A heart brimming with excitement craves adventure. Come, let's celebrate together on this wondrous night of unending fireworks!

title: Whispers of Bliss: Sweetness
ja_name: 心安らぐ言葉・甘い想い
description: Along a path scattered with wildflowers, she searched for unexpected moments hidden among the trees. She longed to etch a surprise in her heart, crafting it into an eternal oil painting that would never fade.

title: Starfall Radiance: Starfire
ja_name: 煌めく流星の刻・星火
description: A meteor shower lights the skies over Florawish, just as it once did in an age touched by war.

title: Dreamy Glimmer: Melody
description: An unknown biologist wandered into the Well of Fortune late one night and stumbled upon a spectacle he'd never forget: Monroefins and Croakers living in perfect harmony, weaving a mesmerizing night symphony.

title: Flowing Colors: Dreamy
ja_name: 筆先に漂う奇彩・絵夢
description: Her brush gently caressed the canvas, sketching a mystical sea of stars. In her solo dance within the dream, she imagined the vibrant splendor of unknown worlds, her thoughts flying alongside shooting stars across the boundless sky.

title: Rippling Serenity: Dream
description: The last rays of sunlight vanished into the mist-covered forest, while the water's surface reflected a spectrum of colors. Anglers, don't reel in your lines, for the fish are about to dance, and a dreamy night is about to unfold.

title: Scaly Dream: Icy Depths
description: Wherever the Loong travels, mist vanishes, ice melts, and frost fractures into flowing streams. The frozen waterways turn into springs, following the Loong as it ascends into the heavens.

title: Shark Mirage: Summer
ja_name: 潮汐のサメの影・楽夏
description: The sailor, finally returning home with bountiful treasures, takes a moment to rest. Lean back on the deck, and bask in the sweet leisure brought by the sea breeze and sunlight.

title: Starlit Celebration: Happiness
description: As starlight fills the night, friends gather around the birthday girl, their laughter melting into golden ripples under the candlelight, spreading warmth to every corner.

title: Gilded Dreamsong: Dawn Painter
description: That arrow brought new hope, and the Celebration Envoy's fairy tale would be rewritten: she bravely exposed the god's lies, shattered the golden greenhouse with her own hands, and found a boundless world beyond the doors.

title: Gilded Dreamsong: Light Follower
description: At the end of the fairy tale, the Celebration Envoy parted ways with her companions and set out on a brand-new journey. But the story's ending is never truly the end. The Shroomseras who left Heaven's Reach are no longer lost, and the courage that lives on in their hearts is the precious gift summer has left behind.

title: Unseen Colors: Concealed
description: All that is deeply longed for must echo aloud. All that burns too brightly must draw shadows in its wake. When discordant shade hangs from the frame, sacred brilliance and greatness become pleas that betray a hidden sorrow.

title: Unseen Colors: Quieted
description: The gears of conspiracy locked her in place, and the truth behind the frame became a prison she chose to inhabit. Her life became one final stroke of heavy oil paint, stubbornly painting a clear blue sky yet to come.

title: Veiled Projections: Lens
description: The curtain had risen. Not even a millennium of dust could hide the past, and before that nearly identical smile, the fluttering film looked even paler.

title: Veiled Projections: Screening
description: Carve out the most dazzling scene, then embrace your applause! Or do you truly wish to cling to that unsettling truth and become a lonely witness to history?

title: Waves' Gratitude
description: A moment's goodness brought the fairy of the Tealwave Pool rushing to repay the kindness. She turned her heartfelt zeal into jewels and a splendid boat, unaware that mortal lives were never brightened in such a way.

title: Waves' Gratitude: Shared Boat
description: At last, she understood the mortal bonds woven between the fishing lights. The best way to repay kindness had never been through gifts or proof, but by walking side by side through the long years and never leaving.

title: Waves' Gratitude: Tidal Shift
description: She wished to bring warmth to Liniang and to shield her from every storm at sea. Yet the feelings entrusted in dreams and the waves held back in the tides fell into the mortal world, and in the end, none became true repayment.

title: Dustwoven Tribute
description: So many praised the sanctity and splendor of the coronation gown, yet she imagined this alone: could the future Queen wear it and step down from her spotless throne? If royal power was destined to hang high in the heavens, she would rather walk toward the earth, accepting flowers offered by others among the mortal dust, or sitting with them to watch the same dawn and dusk.

title: Dustwoven Tribute: Downward
resonance: |description   = When the bells fell silent, the new Queen lifted her layered skirt and descended the long steps. In that moment, the crown was no longer just a symbol held aloft; for the first time, it was touched by the scent of flowers and the warmth of the crowd.
description: When the bells fell silent, the new Queen lifted her layered skirt and descended the long steps. In that moment, the crown was no longer just a symbol held aloft; for the first time, it was touched by the scent of flowers and the warmth of the crowd.

title: Dustwoven Tribute: Expedition
resonance: |description   = The royal finery would never gather dust again. It passed through banquets, streets, and fields alike, accompanying the young Queen as she turned her ideals into daily practice. Time would not wear away its dignity, only make it gentler.
description: The royal finery would never gather dust again. It passed through banquets, streets, and fields alike, accompanying the young Queen as she turned her ideals into daily practice. Time would not wear away its dignity, only make it gentler.

title: Existence Paradox: Morning Star
description: One has worn, battered gears; the other gleams like new. Two shells, alike yet utterly different, stand side by side and resonate in silence. All their past replacements and repairs converge in this moment, gaining renewed life through iteration.

title: Existence Paradox: Rewind
description: It was another quiet rainy night. Lingering fatigue shrouded the workshop, and the lamplight cast the shadow of the Cogbud slowly turning. During a break, the fine rain tapped against the window, and drifting thoughts kept knocking at her heart. Did it, as it had been back then, still exist?

title: Heartboard Crossing
description: A soul hardened into jade; proud bones bloomed with frost. A half-life of obsession dissolved into cold smoke, and her lingering thoughts wandered rivers and seas, not knowing where to go. Only with the board as her crossing and the stones as her guide did she drift away, like fallen blossoms on flowing water, like cold stars chasing the moon over the hills, seeking a final return.

title: Heartboard Crossing: Boughshade
description: Ancient trees loomed, and dreamlike life unfolded. In a realm veiled in deep emerald mist, a wraith quietly laid her game. Vines entwined, the setting sun slanted low, and unseen bonds took hold. Stones spread like stars, awaiting the one who would enter the game. Was it all an illusion or the truth?

title: Heartboard Crossing: Jadeglow
description: With one exultant game, she cleaved mountains and swallowed seas. A half-life of bitter obsession melted like ice into smoke; rolling river waters washed the dust of the past away, while stars, moonlight, and drifting rosy clouds painted her new robes. Dead wood budded with spring, a lost game stirred back to life, and at last she glimpsed the vast world beyond.

title: Kaleidoscopic Splendor
description: Illusion drifts through life, fleeting as dew and lightning. Half a lifetime of worldly fame is nothing but passing smoke. Even across countless rivers and mountains, she will seek the unwavering devotion that lies at the heart of her original passion.

title: Kaleidoscopic Splendor: Chromatic
description: A moment's splendor, a fleeting gleam, enough to crystallize into a lifelong wish. The evening wind said nothing; sudden light appeared. She lifted her gaze and asked the shooting star thrice if she could fulfill her wish.

title: Kaleidoscopic Splendor: Clear Night
description: Gold has its price, but a true heart is priceless. Let the golden crow linger, drawing sunset clouds across the ground. Let ten miles of flame blaze through the night, all to shine upon the starry eyes of children far from home.

title: Painted to Life
description: Illness dragged the sharp-eyed painter into a dazed and muddled swamp. She seized upon an anecdote from the faraway land: in the Titans' Golden Age, mechanical ballerinas were infused with souls, dancing a dance that would never see its curtain fall upon the bearings of time.

title: Painted to Life: Cherished Wish
resonance: |description   = A mechanical shell could not save the painter's soul from its end. The newly reborn ballerina was at a loss; she begged fate not to take the painter's life. The painter smiled stiffly and bid farewell to this eternal moment: from then on, immortal art would leave its blank space to her.
description: A mechanical shell could not save the painter's soul from its end. The newly reborn ballerina was at a loss; she begged fate not to take the painter's life. The painter smiled stiffly and bid farewell to this eternal moment: from then on, immortal art would leave its blank space to her.

title: Painted to Life: Heartwork
