resonance: |description   = The mechanical ballerina longed for a tomorrow when she would dance no more, and her rusted parts proposed a trade of life and death to the painter. Gazing at the sky as its colors faded, the painter refused the offer of immortality and spent the last of her lifeblood painting the ballerina's vivid rebirth.
description: The mechanical ballerina longed for a tomorrow when she would dance no more, and her rusted parts proposed a trade of life and death to the painter. Gazing at the sky as its colors faded, the painter refused the offer of immortality and spent the last of her lifeblood painting the ballerina's vivid rebirth.

title: Drumbeat Wonders
description: A drum beats—thump, thump. Whose memories does it awaken? Which forgotten song does it call forth? How I wish I could bring those stories back to you once more. How I wish I could fill time again with yesterday's laughter. Thump-thump—we still have time. Thump-thump—I'm here with you. Let's keep searching.

title: Drumbeat Wonders: Touring
description: She arrived with the sound of drums and left with laughter. When happiness comes, simply raise the drumsticks high and leave a little joy in every valley you pass through. Let quarrels become the laughter of a marketplace, and let heavy storm clouds scatter into the distance. They will keep marching on forever, until the end of time itself.

title: Drumbeat Wonders: Training
description: Her arms become extensions of the drumsticks. Her heartbeat becomes the lingering echo of the drumbeats. And standing before the drum, she herself becomes the clearest prelude of all. In one moment, she is a drop of dew resting on a leaf at dawn. In another, she is a sigh left behind in the drum's hollow by an old drummer.

title: Leafshade Haven
description: Look, it's her least favorite weather again! Why does the world always seem so hostile, using wind and sudden rain to force her into an airtight room where she taps out a language no one will ever hear, day after day? Until one day, a figure holding a leaf umbrella appears and leads her into a gentler wonderland.

title: Leafshade Haven: Fairytale
ja_name: 一葉の陽だまり・童話
description: Inspired by the umbrella bearer, the girl gently unfolds the story of Elderwood Forest, stepping into a whimsical world where everything is larger than life. There, she becomes a tiny, cherished sprite from a fairy tale. Towering trees stand guard, solemn and strong, shielding her from the elements and wrapping her in a profound sense of safety.

title: Leafshade Haven: Goodnight
ja_name: 一葉の陽だまり・晚安
description: Night fell, and the fairy tale came to an end. The girl returned to the weary roof over her head, yet dreamed the sweetest dream she had ever known. In that dream, she returned once more to the moment beneath the umbrella, when someone had reached out a hand to her. This time, she did not miss it. This time, she reached back.

title: Warm Miracles: Astral Crown
description: The deep night is elusive, and an endless, baffling mystery nests within the twilight. The pink stars look toward the end of the journey, watching the unknown shift and weaving richer imaginings. After the reverie fades, a new signpost for destiny shall be found.

title: Warm Miracles: Shimmer
description: The wonders of the world are frozen in front of the lens, printed into crisp photographs. In Nikki's eyes, there's a tiny city, but also the ends of the world. The brilliant golden sands scatter across the land like stars, shining brightly to guide the path forward.

title: Ashen Butterfly Hymn
description: A prison built in the name of love and protection shields one from storms and fate, but also seals away the vast world beyond. Only when the butterfly flies resolutely into the fire does the final chapter of destiny begin.

title: Ashen Butterfly Hymn: Burning Dream
ja_name: 燼なる蝶の終曲・灼夢
description: The butterfly reduced to ashes in the flames chooses a brief yet incandescent extinction. Such brilliance, paid for with death, cannot be replicated by any gold thread or jewel. Yet that figure plunging into the fire has already become a spark that falls into her heart and ignites into wildfire.

title: Ashen Butterfly Hymn: Frost Night
ja_name: 燼なる蝶の終曲・凛夜
description: She travels alone for thousands of miles to the Boneyard, only to ease a lingering regret. When she finally sees the freely dancing butterfly, she suddenly understands that this, too, is fate's revelation, calling her toward a storm of her own.

title: Steps Against Order: Rebel
description: When Astrid's classmates find her, the "culprit" who once caused trouble at the Cultivarium is peacefully resting beneath the Lumie Tree, lips curled into a mischievous smile. Even when discovered, she shows no sign of discomfort.

title: Steps Against Order: Unruly Fancy
description: When Astrid was young, countless whimsical ideas grew wildly in her mind. If Miraland were to be destroyed one day, what would she become? Though her friends could never quite follow her thoughts, it never dampened her mood.

title: Unawakened Oracle
description: When starlight falls into her eyes, countless visions intertwine before the diviner. She reads the trajectories of fate through the stars, searching within predetermined endings for a single thread of unclosed possibility.

title: Unawakened Oracle: Night Dust
ja_name: 未だ届かぬ神託・夜塵
description: As years pass, the starlight no longer descends. She returns the stars to the heavens and turns toward the mortal world. There is no need to look back at past suffering, as only the present holds infinite hope.

title: Unawakened Oracle: Starweave
ja_name: 未だ届かぬ神託・星織
description: The star trails rotate slowly, cold light descending without sound. She manipulates the threads woven by fate, only to see emptiness and ruin. Only by silent observation of destiny can a fragile thread of survival remain.

title: Evergreen Vow: Covenant
description: Many years later, when refugees from afar stepped into the Boneyard, the dragon remembered her once more—perhaps even tiny humans can carry the weight of a dragon soul refined over a thousand years.

title: Evergreen Vow: Glory
description: Why do what is known to be impossible? The girl stood at the dragon's feet and responded solemnly: Once she decides on something, she will not easily change it; this is the pride of being a knight.

title: Heartward Hues: Dream Colors
description: A young dragon, born unable to perceive color, sees the world in shades of gray and white. Only souls that have yet to depart can cast fleeting bursts of brilliance into her sight. She gathers these vanishing hues within her heart, like keeping a collection of dreams destined, one by one, to end in waking.

title: Heartward Hues: Rainbow
description: As the tide of brilliance ebbs away, she bids farewell to the divine at last. And yet, in the very moment she returns to her kin's domain, she beholds once more the colors she has longed for in her dreams...

title: Luminous Nightflow
description: The kingdom's moon, which once hung high in the sky and illuminated all things, finally sunk into the river's bone-chilling depths. Perhaps it is not moonlight that is eternal, but the desolate, shivering loneliness that remains beneath its glow.

title: Luminous Nightflow: Serene
ja_name: 月夜に流るる光・幽然
description: Only silence possesses depth and weight here; only loneliness transforms into a sigh wandering the wilderness. Colder than death is the void of being forgotten. Those who have lost their names would rather remain trapped in cocoons of their own making.

title: Luminous Nightflow: Soft Melody
ja_name: 月夜に流るる光・軽歌
description: The ferryman departed with the wind as the tides surged silently behind her. Beneath the moonlight, she looked back at her old world, and the final smile she left behind was, at last, no longer for the sake of being remembered.

title: Luster Covenant: Blaze
ja_name: 流れる霊光の契約・熾火
description: The final farewell descends in silence. The awakened soul turns to stardust, returning to the world. In the place where it vanished, new life begins to bloom...

title: Luster Covenant: Phantasm
ja_name: 流れる霊光の契約・幻華
description: Riding the "Lumie's Shadow" across the sky, leaping between mountains and clouds, and savoring the boundless joy of freedom.

title: Petalfall Finale
description: As the lights rise and the curtain parts, she blooms onstage, dazzling all who see her—yet she is also a fleeting meteor across the sky. Her brilliance lasts but a moment; before the world can hold her light in memory, she has already fallen into the boundless night.

title: Petalfall Finale: Adrift
description: Once, the dancer was bound within her own steps, a lone, drifting soul lost in the wilds. Splendor passed and faded, leaving only solitude and obsession—burning like a fierce, unyielding flame that refuses to rest.

title: Petalfall Finale: Cocoon
description: The breeze hums as starlight drifts in a quiet dance. Even the solemn ferryman of legend is willing to be her final audience. Hands clasped, their souls flowing as one—at last, her heart finds its way home, a place of quiet peace.

title: Song of Embers: First Glow
description: The long wandering finally reaches its end. It stops its searching footsteps. In the eternal silence, it seems to see that smile again, as bright as the very first time they met.

title: Song of Embers: Kiss of Fire
description: It could not release the memory of that silhouette dissolving in the flames. In the void that followed, her presence vanished, and so it locked away a past consumed by fire. Through the long years, it has done nothing but piece together the fragments of memory, over and over again.
parts: Dawn of New Life: Kiss of Fire
Song of Freedom: Kiss of Fire
With You in Heart: Kiss of Fire
Throne of Thorns: Kiss of Fire
Old Dream's Shelter: Kiss of Fire

title: Verdant Chord: New Life
ja_name: 心揺らす翠の調べ・新生
description: The forest has long sung the young girl's story—listener of the earth and guardian of nature, a bringer of hope and rebirth. The Great Lumie Tree she once healed still stands in silent grace between heaven and earth, bearing witness to the cycle of life.

title: Verdant Chord: Woven Melody
ja_name: 心揺らす翠の調べ・織音
description: She gathers the thoughts of all living things, weaving them into a melody. As the wind passes through, the forest creatures follow her rhythm, joining in a grand, one-of-a-kind symphony.

title: Whispered Dreams: Covenant
ja_name: 霊語響く夢の狭間・秘契
description: She cast aside all ethereal longings, and in that unbidden moment, she heard the calling from the depths of her soul. No longer did she gaze toward the distant shore; instead, she sought only to become a warm radiance, a light to soothe the suffering souls of this world.

title: Whispered Dreams: Dreamwish
ja_name: 霊語響く夢の狭間・憧夢
description: She once longed to hear the resonance of a soul, yet all she met was endless silence. It was only when the echoes of talent stirred in her veins that she realized every twist and turn had been guiding her toward her destined path.

title: Covenant of Time: Fable
description: Look, the oldest fable has already turned a new page. Look, she and the hearth have lit your new face. You no longer have nightmares, and no longer have sorrow. Tick-tock, time proclaims the truth to desire. From this moment on, you are her.

title: Covenant of Time: Heart Tide
description: Forest, O forest, tell me. Why must I hold this warmth that lies outside our pact? Is this a punishment or a gift? Why am I both sad and joyful? How long until this brand upon my soul leaves me? Tell me, please tell me...
parts: Eternal Twilight of Time: Heart Tide
End of the Mist: Heart Tide
Long Night of Desire: Heart Tide

title: Echoes Upon the Gale: Plaint
description: How many more mute souls have wept their fill in eternal silence? She bade the forest farewell and charged into the crushing darkness ahead. Devouring the silent ashes, a comforting bonfire rose once more upon the plains.

title: Echoes Upon the Gale: Yearning
description: Parting the mists of chance, the dying traveler breathes out a frosted pearl. She cradles that final whisper until it reaches the far-off place he cannot return to. Waiting lover, do you see the longing in his eyes? An unfinished vow is adorned upon the ring finger.
parts: Voice of the Evening Wind: Yearning

title: Heart of the Deep Forest: Crescent Moon
description: Raising high the venom brewed of treachery, she tilted her head and drank it deep, walking toward the fires of hatred. She broke free from her chains, transforming into a giant bird that eclipsed the moon. The dreams in the thieves' minds, once as tame as downy feathers, are to be torn into shreds by an iron shriek, fertilizer that nourishes the forest.

title: Heart of the Deep Forest: Deception
description: Shadows coveting the gemstone lured her into drinking a draught of venom and deceit. They cursed her to hide her sharp edges, to turn herself into a tame bird. These soft, useless feathers and crimson shackles bind her to the earth; the gemstone will lose its loyal sentry.

title: Night Capricorn Song: Melodic Gulp
description: She drinks the fortune-teller's prophecy in one clean gulp. The girl lifts a cup that's broader than the heavens, brimming with starlight, pouring out a riot of destinies that flow quietly at her feet into a vast, gentle river.

title: Night Capricorn Song: Tenderness
description: Pushing aside drooping green vines, she follows the scent of herbs. The fortune-teller offers her a fragrant plant of love, guiding her toward a gentle haven at the end of the road.

title: Rewound Daydream: Absurdity
description: Within the illusion lies a true answer, or perhaps the answer is an illusion, and this realm is real. The Honeybunny's question and the vision of crimson candy now gather absurdity into the palm, allowing the searcher to claim this priceless treasure.

title: Rewound Daydream: Fragrant Fields
description: The sky does not exist for the sake of the land, and Starsilk Fish do not need Whim Pedals. It is the simplest truth, yet we so often forget: beauty's dance needs no comparisons for shoes.

title: The Fifth Flavor: Floating Wishes
description: Angelina sets aside the original script of "Perfect Idol." Carefully, she weaves a new story into a net of her own making, a wish-seeking journey that exists only in her imagination, entrusting wandering hopes to a pastry chef's uniform.

title: The Fifth Flavor: Renewal
description: Spira finally awakens from its dream. Labobo and Roucoco exchange a glance and toss aside the old script in unspoken agreement. This time, they choose to tell a story of love and sincerity hidden within pastries.

title: Visionary Dreamer: Clear Sky
description: A wind blew by the crowded drink shop. Instead of stirring up pieces of grass like before, it then carried sweet scents of fruits, ice-chilled air, and countless murmurs of satisfaction and happiness.

title: Visionary Dreamer: Verdant Forest
description: The lines on the sketches, once quiet and still, were coming alive thanks to the countless small but warm favors. Little by little, surrounded by the wind and greenery, they would weave into a new reality, both sweet and real.

title: Formless Truth: Heartbound
description: The auspicious hour arrives, and the tribute is complete. A hundred days of patient, focused labor have brought countless forms into harmonious unity. It raised no grand altar for gods, but traced the ordinary lives of every household. When the self is set aside, the forms of all beings emerge; when empty fame is forsaken, the work becomes an enduring praise of life itself.

title: Formless Truth: Tracing
description: Born into a land of unrest, she was mortal yet bore a heart of compassion. She lifted the guiding light herself, carrying a single flame across a thousand miles. Though the lands she crossed remember her no more, the heavenly maiden's name endures—her virtue passed down through generations, her light still shining among the stars.

title: Moonlit Immortal: Fleeting Life
ja_name: 月下に舞う飛仙・惜陰
description: The moon waxed and waned, year after year, ever the same. Blessed to be a dancer, she fulfilled the vow of her life. Born like the dark of the new moon, she gradually grew full and radiant. As the soul of the dance faded, beneath the remnant glow of a jade crescent moon, the scene was lonely and desolate, yet it was nothing more than a return to life's vast, uncharted expanse.
parts: Call of the Heart: Fleeting Life

title: Moonlit Immortal: Last Banquet
ja_name: 月下に舞う飛仙・別宴
description: When the dance reached its end, her body remained trapped like a bird in a cage, while her soul soared with utmost feeling, shattering heaven's light. In the deep night, her feathers gleamed brilliantly; her spirit flew across clear tones, while all sounds fell silent, save for the occasional delicate trill.

title: Nefarious Shadows: Enlightened
description: The lantern-lit streets still burned bright, yet the once-hidden illusions took form and then began to settle. She laid the false visions flat as a traversable path, stepping upon flowing light as though it were solid ground. Following the winding lamps that guided the way, her mind grew clear and her sight unclouded, and her body moved with lightness and ease.

title: Nefarious Shadows: Ethereal
description: Deep into the night, light and shadow danced in disarray. Though the crimson pavilion remained unchanged and the emerald waves undisturbed, the veneer of splendor had already cracked beneath her gaze. Seeing through the old delusion, misty shadows emerged, revealing that the flickering tails of lanterns were not mere dreams, and the mirage-like light drifting through the air was both false and true.

title: Perfect Moment: Jade Peak
description: Paper-cutting was no child's play; a heartfelt devotion was folded in every shape. The east wind rolled the paper into a path, guiding the girl beyond the courtyard to witness the vibrance of the world.

title: Perfect Moment: Misted
description: The thin mist curled and unfurled, flowers false and real alike. Inside her chamber, she crafted paper plays, her skill turning paper into living illusions. Yet no matter how many times she rehearsed, when the play ended and the music faded, it was still just her, a table, a chair, and a box of paper.

title: Poem of Emberlight: Dizzy
ja_name: 輝火の叙す長詩・微芒
description: The forest whispered its past to the girl. Long ago, an unnamed soul gave their life to purify the land. Beneath the moon, vows were sworn, inscribing a sealed legend into an eternal poem. Generations carried that undying glimmer, nurturing a future that slowly took root.

title: Poem of Emberlight: Unspoken
ja_name: 輝火の叙す長詩・忘言
description: The girl stepped into a forest soaked in morning dew. At last, she saw with her eyes a hidden realm veiled beneath a gauze of mist. Deep within the woods, a poem sealed by time seemed to murmur softly.

title: Song Beyond: Longing
description: Fate was cruel; within the bounds of destiny, every step constrained the body. Yet the heart, ice-pure, crossed mountains and seas to meet at last.. Looking back, a thousand calamities passed like water; only true devotion illuminated the eternal dust.

title: Song Beyond: Unparting
description: Clouds gathered and dispersed; white feathers traced shadow and form, while hidden fragrance kept company with drifting years. Tides rose and fell; moonlight endured unchanged, its clear radiance brushing the sorrow from her brow.

title: Tasting the World: Honey Brew
ja_name: 尋ぬし俗世の味・蜜漬
description: The warm and vibrant flavors exuding from dishes cooked by earthen stoves awoke her weary palate. Even if she had tasted a thousand delicacies, the most comforting remained that one bite of blissful sweetness buried deep in memory.

title: Tasting the World: Quintessence
ja_name: 尋ぬし俗世の味・醍醐
description: Delicacies glided over the tongue, their flavors rich and varied, yet failed to touch the heart. Burdened by empty fame and fleeting gain, even with the most sensitive palate, she could not discern the true flavor. Declining invitations from renowned restaurants, she turned instead toward the bustling alleys and lanes.

title: Thousand Flames: Kindled
ja_name: 千焔燃ゆ花明り・夢燃
description: From her hands, a thousand lanterns bloomed, their flames mirroring the sky. Remembering that moment beneath the lights, her eyes shone—bright as the moon breaking through clouds. Warmth settled in her palm as the lantern rested there, moonlight filling her thoughts, her heart anchored in this life.

title: Thousand Flames: Reverie
ja_name: 千焔燃ゆ花明り・遥思
description: She drew a strand of starlight from the Milky Way and shaped it into a warm lantern, unwilling to keep such brilliance to herself. She hoped it would guide travelers cloaked in frost and snow, its light reaching across miles of the mortal world.

title: Dancing Pearl: Offering
description: The life of the Weavespider ended quietly in its delicate web, yet the unfulfilled sensations surged again in her heart, composing a new prelude. Her dress swirled like a full moon, dancing gracefully—not for the stage, but because she had found her home.

title: Dancing Pearl: Silent Life
description: She shone like a speck of light in the cold night, drawing countless fragile creatures close. With quiet resolve, she wove the tremors and silences of the forgotten into her dance, leaving tender footnotes for all the neglected souls.
parts: Vines of the Silent: Silent Life

title: Solitary Silhouette: Scar
description: She once considered herself a mere observer, drawn to the quiet treetops, turning her back on the clamor of the forest. But when she saw the ancient tree scarred by the axe, and a dying fledgling wail beside its toppled nest, she could no longer remain indifferent. How could she not resolve to protect them?

title: Solitary Silhouette: Silent Vigil
description: Countless lives brushed past her, unspoken yet united in guarding the forest; strangers yet aligned on the same invisible threads. Like kindred spirits, they resonated under the same stars.

title: Verdant Verse: Cycle
description: The bard wove this cycle of life into a verse, for all who could understand it. She said, "Having heard the spring dew shatter upon the moss, having witnessed horns bloom into flowers, each sound of the tambourine honors those who depart and blesses those who arrive."

title: Verdant Verse: Flare
description: It was a chance, and it was inevitable. A melody awoke from her fingertips, a line of verse roused the forest. One life, and another life—melody and verse spoke their hearts. It was a rapturous, golden dance, so intoxicating that the night forgot the passage of time.

title: Deepwood Dream: New Voice
ja_name: 遥かな深林の夢・新声
description: The old friends had all passed away. Time flowed on without end, leaving only songs in the wind, murmuring sorrow and remembrance. The days shared with companions never faded. Even now, with eyes closed, their laughter still echoes.

title: Deepwood Dream: Twilight Song
ja_name: 遥かな深林の夢・夕歌
description: The scorching wind carried the distant mountains' lament. Starlight in the forest was veiled by thick smoke, and the tranquil nocturne came to an abrupt end. The fire that once illuminated laughter suddenly turned into a nightmare that devoured all.

title: Feathery Song: Harmony
description: The young girl, lost and alone, met the hospitable Shroomlings who kick-started her amazing adventure in Spira. They sang and danced all night long, and planted the seed of friendship. With trust and gratitude, the girl weaved a feathery gown from her hometown, hoping the brief journey would leave an everlasting mark.

title: Feathery Song: New Verse
description: The adventurer never stopped, for the next journey called out to them. The young girl may have bid farewell to the Shroomlings, but the story of their lives would be passed down in songs. Such miraculous encounters would be remembered by the land.
parts: Will of the Wind: New Verse

title: Forest Folk: Concealed Night
ja_name: 森に芽吹きし新角・夜帳
description: Under a veil of darkness, a neat line of Shroomlings traversed the forest toward the warm lamplights of Spira, when their leader got lost and led them into a Behemoth's territory...

title: Forest Folk: Dark Afterglow
ja_name: 森に芽吹きし新角・紺霞
description: After growing giant, she should take every step carefully to avoid stomping on plants that are doing their best to grow. It's also necessary to practice how to hold back a sneeze to avoid startling fledglings just learning to fly.

title: Forest's Song: Dewdrop
description: Sometimes, the lonesome Shawl Deer would run into danger. A girl once emerged from the light of dawn and helped it escape from a hunt, which imprinted its memory with a warm light that would never go out.

title: Forest's Song: Twilight Silhouette
description: As it followed the girl's path, it accidentally witnessed a scene that was destined to become legend, a scene of protection and new life, of promise and goodbyes...

title: Shadow Swiftweave: Leap
ja_name: 残影のシャトル・跳林
description: "Whoosh!" A figure swung out from the sky-high branches and the misty morning light, rising with overflowing joy.

title: Shadow Swiftweave: Mountain Mist
ja_name: 残影のシャトル・青霧
description: It was a slow afternoon, with no thrilling leaps, nor a clear destination. Instead, there was a clear blue spring, carefree critters, and a traveler who put away the Sticky Claw and the weight of speed and purpose, if only for a moment.

title: Silent Ode: Devoted Heart
description: The kingdom appointed her to deliver people's prayers to the divine maiden. Day by day, the words she passed on slowly became tainted by greed, but she could only watch as they gradually wore down the divine maiden... Perhaps, everything was twisted from the start.

title: Silent Ode: Judgment
description: Upon learning the truth, a rage unlike any she had ever known surged through her. If the dark spirit were the cruelest force in the world, then she would wield its ways to deliver judgment and vengeance. As the kingdom burned to ashes, she saw the divine maiden offer a long-awaited smile.

title: Starwoven Dreams: Dusk Clouds
description: The dancer danced with the Shroomlings all night by the cabin, her passion slowly opening the door to the reclusive girl's heart. The dancer spoke of fun and amazing tales from across the land, but the girl only responded with silence and sighs.

title: Starwoven Dreams: Gilded Night
description: The dancer wanted to free the girl from fate's shackles, but the girl didn't want to slow down the dancer's carefree steps. When they eventually parted, the girl finally told her life story, her eyes briefly filled with hatred and regret.

title: Sweet Waltz: Honeyed Amber
description: While guarding the Mothershroom, the Guardian Beast sensed an "invader" and charged toward the source, ready to fight, only to find a Shroomling from a bug-catching squad who got too absorbed in the task and wandered into Mothershroom Woods by mistake.

title: Sweet Waltz: Serene Stars
description: Chasing butterflies fluttering in pairs, seeing the brilliant daylight turn into twinkling stars, the lost Shroomling danced a waltz with the Mothershroom's spore shower. However, this adventure has yet to conclude...

title: Counterflow Concerto: Break
description: Can rock break its own boundaries? Blend in the languor of jazz, the breath of blues, and the pull of pop. Hmm, maybe it's worth a try...

title: Counterflow Concerto: Runaway
description: It was the perfect rock experience. Synths, snares, noise, and a crowd brimming with unstoppable passion. Let chaos reign! We've got youth and freedom to burn!

title: Golden Buds: Ashes
description: Familiar faces faded in the licking flames, the searing pain forever etched into his palms, his chest, and each sleepless night haunted by longing. Lorelei's ashes had scattered to the wind, but the new melody was steeped in a cost known to no one.

title: Golden Buds: Cadenza
ja_name: 金色の根芽・カデンツァ
description: Come on! Come see the Lorelei Troupe! The Troupe's name was making headlines in the papers, and Ennio still had his companions—his family—by his side. Back then, he never imagined parting ways. With a heart full of hope, he dreamed of what the next decade together might bring.

title: Starry Nocturne: Resound
description: The moment she signed her name on the contract, she knew: luck and talent alone would not be enough. Her dream never wavered, but she longed to shine brighter, and to bring more joy with her voice. Then, her name would echo through every street and alley.

title: Starry Nocturne: Sunrise
description: Dreams? They are the tears of yesterday that water today's growth. They are the wings grown through pain, crashing toward a sky so blue it hurts. They are the nights of dancing and singing till your throat goes hoarse. They're the doorway she finally found: brilliant, unknown, and full of light.

title: Gossamer Moonfairy: Airy
description: Thought forgotten and unknown, light suddenly broke through the dark willows—a wanderer returned. A false birthdate could not hold such deep sincerity. The heart's chaos worsened like catkins drifting in late spring. If there was regret, it was hard to explain or undo.

title: Gossamer Moonfairy: Night Light
description: She once mistook true hearts for hollow words, misjudging depth with fleeting eyes. But no great harm was done, no bitter end cast. Regret came not too late. In the ever-turning world, where right and wrong blur like dust in wind, their bond endures, and when fate allows, they shall meet again.

title: Lifetime Yin Yuan: Other Shore
description: Say not this life betrayed a devoted heart. The peach blossoms weep blood for a reason. A single hairpin, a single fan, both hiding old vows. In the next life, destined souls will meet again. True love in this world flows on and on, life after life, never-ending.

title: Lifetime Yin Yuan: Peachwood Fan
description: When it was just a tender shoot, its rustling leaves answered the girl's call. Grown into a lush canopy, it sheltered her from the wind and rain with clouds of blossoms. Even when only a stump remained after the disaster, its rings still kept secret words. In the end, its wood was carved into a fan, and it showered her with petals as they parted.

title: Lotus Heart: Homecoming
description: Youth bloomed by day and faded by night; the rosy cheeks lasted but an instant, petals scattered on the water freely drifting. Yet trusted friends still looked back, and the painted world held its warmth. The heart finally found its peace.

title: Lotus Heart: Longing
description: The orchid boat glides where osmanthus oars part the mist's veil, through haze that swells and sighs without fail. Half-drowned in moonlit wine, the gazer sees two worlds align—lotus faces, hearts now twined, where jade waves wed cloud-torn skies in waters divine.

title: Sword Master: Red Leaves
description: One stroke splits the sky, ink still wet, mountains rise where green is met. I seem a guest within the scroll, a painted world, alive in heart.

title: Sword Master: Twilight Whisper
description: Scarlet flames engulfed the city; the lone sword master bled, her blade failing. The artist's brush transformed fire into a thousand acres of autumn maples. Saddened, she painted the burning sky as dusk and scorched the earth.

title: Thought in Bloom: First Light
description: Where warblers sang in warm sunlight, the breeze through the grass carried the scent of herbs. East of the herb fence, west of the herb fence, one still remembered that promise made in the rain. Tender green shoots arched like slender brows, as a tiny butterfly came to rest among them.

title: Thought in Bloom: Moonlit Veil
description: Yin Yuan binds, compassion endures. Mother and daughter both chose to face the burden of healing all lives. With hearts clear and steadfast, they became like the pure moon in the sky, casting its light across every river and stream.

title: Far and Away: Dream Journey
ja_name: 遥か彼方への想い・夢旅
description: She closed her eyes, sinking into soft dreams, where the special adventure chapter began. The thoughts she couldn't finish during the day's journey were now entrusted to her dream-self.

title: Mistbound Whispers: First Meet
ja_name: 林霧の語りもの・初遇
description: Ten million tales, ten million faces. Some called her a ghost, others a fairy. But she was no mystery to unravel, she was the answer history left behind as the wheel of time turned.

title: Mistbound Whispers: Warmth
ja_name: 林霧の語りもの・余温
description: The mist concealed her face, time wiped away her trace, and ancient legends left behind only silent relics. A faded scale stirred countless emotions, carrying forward her selflessness and warmth.

title: Nightlight Whispers: Distant Flower
description: Far away from here lies a sea of flowers, and those returning to their hometown are greeted by its fragrant embrace. If you see the girl bathed in petals like rain, ask her to weave a promised flower crown for you.

title: Nightlight Whispers: Shimmer
description: Even a withered flower can bloom again with fresh rain. Even a ruined town can shine once more with hope and love. In the days ahead, quiet anticipation will always take root and grow anew.

title: Cloud Daydreams
description: Oh, to be a carefree child again, chasing clouds on a steamy afternoon.

title: Cloud Daydreams: Jade Glint
description: As she grew up and left the towering city behind, her steps led her to a wilderness where soft breezes wandered and clouds slowly drifted over the horizon. At this sight, long-lost childhood dreams began to resurface in her heart.

title: Cloud Daydreams: Night Wander
description: When she thought back, even those quiet nights spent watching the shimmering clouds drifting by glowed faintly in the vast night of her memory.

title: Hometown Breeze: Vigilance
description: Far from home, the departed hope their homeland won't forget them, while forgotten garments stand as silent sentinels over those who journey onward. The wind blows through the Stonetrees, carrying wishes that turn into quiet guardians, drifting through the remnants of others' past lives.

title: Rebirth Wish: Renewal
description: Rebuilding the ruins with shared wishes, the people of Florawish made new wishes for a fresh start after its revival... As they did so, little paper cranes flew into every corner of their lives.

title: Twilight Oath
description: The brave and kind-hearted little prince set out on a journey to face the darkness, toward the ancient castle where the Slumber Sheep rests. To safeguard his people, he would not falter, even if he might be trapped in a dream he could never escape.

title: Twilight Oath: Blaze
ja_name: 霧と夜明けの誓い・灼光
description: After enduring countless hardships, the little prince finally returned to his homeland. The strength and support of his companions had granted him a rebirth, and the light forged from courage and selflessness would ultimately crown him with the world's brightest glory.

title: Twilight Oath: Slumber
ja_name: 霧と夜明けの誓い・安眠
description: In the castle shrouded by the forest, the slumbering little prince once dreamed of his distant homeland. It was a place of peace and tranquility, where the people lived happily and the shepherdess would sing a beautiful song as he passed through the meadows—though, alas, it was all but an illusion.

title: Afternoon Shine: Lakeside
ja_name: 陽だまりの午後・湖畔
description: Strolling by the waterside on a sunny afternoon, leaping gracefully onto a lotus leaf and gazing down to discover a delightful surprise beneath the gentle ripples of laughter—a Gogglebug swimming gracefully in the water.

title: Breezy Tea Time: Gummy
ja_name: 爽やかなお茶会・軟糖
description: Taste the soft, chewy gummy, its sweet flavor spreading throughout your mouth, making you forget all your worries. Welcome to the exclusive gummy treats at the Bowtie Cat's afternoon tea party!

title: Bubbly Voyage: Mountgale
description: The newborn bubbles drift with the wind, wandering through the meandering mountains, shaping their initial impressions of the world.

title: Celestial Whispers: Cloud Serenade
ja_name: 星と月の目覚め・雲歌
description: The bewilderment following the hidden adventure transforms into a fairytale melody, as the legend of rainbows and bubbles is whispered through the golden wheat fields. When the music plays softly, it lingers, carrying the memory of a sweet dream resting among clouds.

title: Celestial Whispers: Night Wander
ja_name: 星と月の目覚め・夜遊
description: What cannot be found is gifted by dreams, and what cannot be reunited is woven by them. Once, beyond the clouds, an island appeared on the horizon, never to be dismissed as mere mirage. Guided by the traveler's melody, memories stir, and the island is dreamt of as though drifting through the depths of night.

title: Daughter of the Lake: Radiance
description: Under a night where neon lights weave and flicker, she drifts aimlessly, her gaze lost in the fading trails of falling stars. As dawn approaches, a quiet emotion stirs upon the lake's surface. In that moment, she realizes that the brilliant path she has been chasing is the very one she has been walking all along.

title: Dream Banquet: Soft Meadow
description: The fairy tale's sequel tells that, after time had quietly passed, the princess finally stepped beyond the castle gates. She rested gently on the grass, while the Bullquet roamed nearby, bringing her bouquets in its mouth.

title: Floral Memory: Breezy
ja_name: 追想に舞う花弁・風綿
description: Yearning for the boundless sky, I ride the wind to the place where memories dwell. As dusk slowly fades and the silhouettes of the past take shape in the dim light, I find myself whispering the wind's murmurs within my mind.

title: Fully Charged: New Light
ja_name: 器を満たす伝導・新光
description: The street was once a barren wilderness, with streetlights taking the place of the moon. As the world hums to life, I stand at the crossroads of circuitry and nature, where the fields meet the winds.

title: Gleaming Dance: Verdant
description: Walking along the edge of the ballroom, the young girl leans gently against the window, a soft smile gracing her lips as she stands still. Though she no longer spins, the night clings to the hem of her gown, unwilling to let go.

title: Harvest's Blessing: Starlight
description: The wind that sweeps across the fields carries the lingering warmth of midday songs. Hand in hand, they walk down the familiar path home. Though this road has been traveled a thousand times, it now feels new, as the dawn breathes life into the faded reverie.

title: Harvest's Blessing: Wind
description: They once shared dreams between the morning dew and the setting sun-dreams of pages and wheat fields, of distant lands and home. Now, though separated by distance, those years continue to grow, bearing rich golden grain that sways in the wind.

title: Midnight Vigil: Return
ja_name: 真夜中の見守り・帰路
description: On a night ablaze with drifting fireworks, laughter cannot disturb the orderly march of the Floofs. Amid the child's curious questions, an unyielding starlight blooms in her eyes, shimmering with the echoes of past vows and unwavering watchfulness.

title: New Bloom Blessings: Endless Joy
description: Lantern light dances on freshly sewn garments. Golden threads are gently woven, carrying a wish that shines bright and endless. May this year be free of worries, and may we share in the beauty of the world together.

title: New Year's Dawn: Peach Blossom
description: At the tips of tender buds, the first peach blossoms begin to unfurl. With a friend by her side, she steps deeper into the heart of spring, as the warm breeze sweeps through every alley.

title: Pink Ribbon Waltz: Spin
ja_name: ローゼリボンワルツ・円転
description: There was a time when her steps wavered, her heart adrift like a lone wanderer in an endless, uncertain night. But then, the lake shimmered softly, and the Pink Ribbon Eel swayed its tail, reigniting the forgotten embers of her inspiration. She picked up her dance shoes, took the first step, and let hope gently twirl in the stillness before dawn.

title: Rosy Reverie: Moss
description: At last, she takes the long-awaited step forward. The city remains asleep, the world hushed, with only the steady echo of her heartbeat. She departs along the moss-covered path, moving quietly through the forest. As morning light filters through the trees, a distant manor emerges—silent, yet answering the unspoken longing within her.

title: Rosy Reverie: Ripples
ja_name: 夢燃やす幻花・さざ波
description: Ripples form, carrying the scent of fine wine, gently drifting into her heart. The warmth of its intoxication spills over, nourishing her soul as it awakens.

title: Starlet Burst: Green Shore
ja_name: 瞬く小さな星光・緑の畔
description: Turn into a little star, fall into the embrace of green, and listen carefully to the sounds of flowers and grass. Wow, it's time for an exciting adventure!

title: Sweet Jazz Nights: Afternoon Dream
ja_name: ナイトジャズの恋人・昼夢
description: On a dreamy afternoon nap, a gentle knock sounds at the door of the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club. Order a glass of mixed juice and set the stage for a laid-back afternoon dance party.

title: The Queen's Move: Unfinished
ja_name: クイーンの遊戯・終盤
description: Step by step, the opponent's king is cornered into an inescapable trap. Though it may seem like the game is unfinished, the outcome has already been sealed.

title: Verdant Melodies: Journey's End
ja_name: 緑野の軽やかな歌・帰刻
description: When will they meet again? Perhaps when she has read every scroll in the cabinet, when the migrating birds return, when flowers bloom upon the trellis, or when the Silken Lake sways once more to an old, familiar song.

title: Water's Echo: Melody
ja_name: せせらぐ水の導き・希音
description: She hears the murmurs of the water, walking through the ebb and flow of desolation and abundance. She calls out the name of her homeland, and the waters respond with rain, wheat fields, and a silent, overflowing fullness.

title: Water's Echo: Wave Song
ja_name: せせらぐ水の導き・波歌
description: What could be faster than the raging flames of war? She gazed at the surging river, then leaped in. "Take me with you," she whispered, "let me become the torrent that heralds the storm, so that all may hear the river's call."

title: Wind of Purity: Unbloomed
description: Someone once said that the wind is a poet wandering the earth, witnessing life and death upon the land. So let the poet quietly tell a story about itself and a tiny seed.

title: The Queen's Move: Endgame
ja_name: クイーンの遊戯・支配
description: The cold light on the chessboard catches the eyes, outlining the confrontation between the red and blue squares, as a battle of wit and will is about to unfold.

title: Dream Banquet: Rebirth
description: Later, the story of the little princess continued to echo through Wishfield. It's said that once, someone saw the little princess and the Bullquet sitting together under the starry sky, gathered around a tea table, with starlight scattered across the hem of her flowing dress.

title: Midnight Vigil: Embark
ja_name: 真夜中の見守り・旅立ち
description: When their eyes met, faded memories were reignited, and the past years came into focus once more. Floofs, line up! This time, standing together, looking forward to a brighter tomorrow.

title: New Bloom Blessings: Meadow
ja_name: 新歳の賀慶・春の野原
description: The joys of the early days are far from fading, as laughter and cheer fill the fragrant courtyard. The perfect time to wander is now, when the earth is draped in vibrant green. I long to share this beauty with you.

title: New Year's Dawn: Spring Tea
description: When spring arrives, brew a pot of tea with the morning dew and await the arrival of those who will enjoy the tea with you.

title: Verdant Melodies: Farewell
ja_name: 緑野の軽やかな歌・惜別
description: The sunlight gradually fades, and the laughter and cheer of the crowd slowly fade away. As the sky transitions over time, the moment of farewell quietly arrives.

title: Dream-Like Night: Lost
description: Silence streamed between them. Memory climbed their faces like creeping vines. They both pursued illusory dreams, and nearly lost themselves. In that instant, they both sank into the innocence of their pasts.

title: Dream-Like Night: Resolve
description: Open your eyes, even if the path ahead is not smooth. Listen carefully, even to cries of pain. Life may strike us with suffering, but we answer it with the courage to face it!

title: Glimmering Forest: Dawn Path
description: The emerald land that birthed fairytales would not fade into time's deep valley. When the birds brought the Shroomling's pleas for help, she would step onto the journey without hesitation, wherever the future might lead.

title: Glimmering Forest: Twilight Hymn
description: Thinking of the distant deep forest, where the Shroomlings await her return, the rugged path beneath her feet seems to smooth out, her weariness fading as memories ease the fatigue of the journey.

title: Sweet Memories: First Light
description: Morning light brushes the edges of her dreams. She begins rewriting her own recipes. The moment her pen touches the page, the long-missed thrill floods her like a tsunami, as if she's back in those afternoons baking with her mother—the air sweet, the oven warm.

title: Sweet Memories: Past
description: On the path to inheriting the pastry legacy, her mother's recipes had grown into an insurmountable mountain. She felt trapped within the familiar sweetness and memories. Her mother's shadow loomed over her, obscuring her own self...

title: Woodland Nesting: Ashes
description: One night, flames flare up unexpectedly, consuming every green memory and leaving only endless gray-black stillness. She wipes her tears and looks toward the distant ashes—something stubbornly flickers, bright against the darkness.

title: Woodland Nesting: Dream Invitation
description: Was it a dream? From the mist emerged an enormous green bird, its sweeping tail trailing violet lights that shimmered like twilight beneath the dome. Drawn by the drifting haze, the girl wandered on until she reached a painted vision—a boundless field of pale purple flowers, swaying gently in the wind.

title: Cloud Reverie: Misty Rain
description: She stood barefoot along the ridges of the field, quietly listening to the pulse deep within the soil. The evening wind brushed across the heavy wheat grains, rustling softly. In her eyes there was no more weariness, only the moonlight illuminating the harvest.

title: Cloud Reverie: Sun
description: Once, time had seemed endless. Now, it felt fleeting. Amid the crowd, she recalled countless stages, and on each one, countless versions of herself. The golden harvest before her had already given her the right answer to her heart's question.

title: Courtyard Flowers: Growth
ja_name: 古庭に咲く花思い・蔓生ゆ
description: New flowers quietly grew atop memories tied to you, and their familiar fragrance finally freed me from the old mire. I set forth from the past toward the horizon, seeds marking my footsteps, and my homeland resting in my heart.

title: Courtyard Flowers: Tangled Dreams
ja_name: 古庭に咲く花思い・囚夢
description: You silently drifted away on a hidden evening breeze, taking all fragrance with you. Yesterday's reflections froze into chains beneath my feet. Grandmother, how I longed to rest forever in your last smile. I thought I would never find a dream garden scented with your presence again.

title: Grains of Yesterday: Distant Song
ja_name: 昨日を行きし穂風・遥歌
description: The last rays of sunlight retreated from the fields, and the night sky gently kissed her and the wheat beside her. She gazed at the stars, unsure whether she wished to be a rooted grain or a wandering star.

title: Grains of Yesterday: New Bud
ja_name: 昨日を行きし穂風・若芽
description: She walked barefoot along the edges of the fields as usual, her gaze sweeping across the green ridges. Planting season had passed; the busy fields had fallen quiet. In her heart, that quiet meadow opened its first seam to the wind.

title: Daughter of the Lake: Star
description: Endless shooting stars remain distant; neon-lit bays are now her haven. Once-wild plains and upstream struggles were destiny's softest trials. At last, the young fish hides her wounded heart in the night.

title: Gleaming Dance: Finale
description: As the bright lights of the ballroom fade from view, the girl steps gracefully into the courtyard, embraced gently by the night. Captivated by the enchanting scenery, she finds herself lost in its spell.

title: Pink Ribbon Waltz: Variation
ja_name: ローゼリボンワルツ・変奏
description: No longer drawn to the spotlight, she finds a glow behind the mist that recalls her first dance. When tears and sweat merge into new rivers, she swims toward the next shooting star, like a Pink Ribbon Eel chasing its dreams.

title: Afternoon Shine: Rain
ja_name: 陽だまりの午後・雨明
description: The gentle patter of rain washes away fatigue, bringing a refreshing breeze. As the sky clears after the shower, the Sockos peek out from their hiding spots. Grab your finest gear and go catch them!

title: Breezy Tea Time: Siesta
ja_name: 爽やかなお茶会・後憩
description: Invited by the Bowtie Cat, I come to an afternoon salon where time seems to slow down. With the company of red tea, sweet cakes, dear friends, and the Bowtie Cat, the hustle and bustle of the outside world fade into the background.

title: Bubbly Voyage: Spring
description: Continuing its journey, guided by the fragrance of spring, the bubble witnesses the vibrant colors of life.

title: Far and Away: Future
ja_name: 遥か彼方への想い・前途
description: Embarking anew with the dawn's glow, may this journey stretches on, for there lies a tapestry of vibrant landscapes beyond, waiting for us to discover together!

title: Floral Memory: Gleam
ja_name: 追想に舞う花弁・瞬光
description: Gently bidding farewell to that land once more, the days that floated in the air like drifting petals gradually fade away, but the memories in my mind remain vivid.

title: Fully Charged: Refreshing
ja_name: 器を満たす伝導・美影
description: The playful contrasting colors are like sparkling water on a hot summer day. Simply gazing upon them fills you with joy and vitality. The expert electrician never seems to tire, always brimming with energy as she brings light to everyone.

title: Hometown Breeze: Hopeful
description: As Lavenfringes bloom, and one by one, adorable Florist Sheep stroll leisurely among the flowers, the people of Prosperville finally start a vibrant new life.

title: Rebirth Wish: Blooming
description: The statue of The Wishing One, holding the Aurosa Scepter, has been officially unveiled as the reconstruction nears completion. People gather before the statue, making heartfelt wishes, hoping that Florawish will remain peaceful and serene forever.

title: Starlet Burst: Glow
ja_name: 瞬く小さな星光・蛍光
description: Once I have shrunk in size, I roll around in the sweet pollen, transforming into a dazzling golden star!

title: Sweet Jazz Nights: Waltz
ja_name: ナイトジャズの恋人・輪舞
description: The joyful waltz at the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club is all the rage. It's said that the music draws inspiration from the songs of the Cadenceborn, while the dance steps mimic the playful spins of Bibcoons with their yarn balls.

title: Wind of Purity: Dawn
description: The dawn breaks through the veil of night, painting the sky with hues of hope. Under this eternal glow of sunlight, the shadows that linger over the continent will have nowhere to hide.

title: Danqing Craft: Gold Jade
description: The boundless land unfurled in nature's frame, where sunset bled through mist in gold and jade's bright flame. Before this scroll, her soft song rose with ease—sip by sip, she drank heaven's perfect peace.

title: Danqing Craft: Maple
description: In water-cloud villages where maple fires glow, ink cascades drunk in waves' hypnotic flow—each brushstroke dreams of homeland's grace, where miles of river-mountains fill a single space.

title: Starwish Echoes: Devotion
description: Once every two centuries, the Aurosa blooms as promised, and countless dormant lives await their awakening. On this day, they bask in the radiant blessings and eager hopes. The miracles of the Millewish Sprite transcend time, inspiring the power of a new generation's wishes.

title: Bye-Bye Dust: Spring Purity
ja_name: ふわもこに溺れる・清春
description: On a damp spring afternoon, the little animals chase each other and play on the grass. After their joyful playtime comes to an end, it's time for a good cleaning!

title: Momo Rain: Newly Ripe
ja_name: モモ雨との邂逅・新熟
description: The pink fruits are nearly ripe, filling the garden with a rich fragrance. But what if it suddenly starts to rain? Momo quickly replies, "Hurry, put raincoats on the trees!"

title: Symphony of Strings: Sunlit Serenity
ja_name: 指先で奏でる叙情詩・晴光
description: Beneath the clear sky, the strings hum, their melody flowing like a warm breeze blessing the beautiful afternoon.

title: Momo Rain: Starry Colors
ja_name: モモ雨との邂逅・星の彩り
description: When the rain stopped, a shooting star streaked across the sky. Momo looked up just in time to see its luminous trail fading, painting the night in shimmering stardust. Beneath the glittering expanse, Momo closed his eyes and made a little wish.

title: Bye-Bye Dust: Kitty
ja_name: ふわもこに溺れる・猫友
description: To commemorate a delightful afternoon encounter with a Shirtcat, this special design was created!

title: Starwish Echoes: Promise
description: Long after, amidst the embers of war, the reigning Wish Master stepped into the long-forgotten sanctuary. From that moment on, the power of wishes and promises intertwined. Once, people relied solely on their strength to achieve their desires; now, he too was determined to fulfill his promises through unwavering efforts.

title: Symphony of Strings: Woods
ja_name: 指先で奏でる叙情詩・林中
description: The grand stage has drawn to a close, so now step gracefully into the forest, where listeners still await a serenade under the moonlight.

title: Bouncy Spirit
description: She puts on her cap, turns up the headphones, and with each move, the little bunny on her crossbody bag bounces up and down. There is no destination today, but every step brings a lovely view.

title: Old Court Treasures
description: She follows the old corridor, recognizing the treasures time has hidden, and in the newborn light of dawn, she understands how old stories once shone.

title: Sun-Chasing Breeze
description: She still remembers that morning, leaping onto her horse to face the sunrise on the horizon. Leaving old rules behind, she rode freely toward the light destined to be hers.

title: Tropical Holiday
description: Sunshine and ocean breeze invite you into a holiday embrace. Nature's vibrant hues wash ashore with the tide, capturing the brilliant coastal scenery in a heartfelt smile. Here, anxiety fades, and life blooms freely.

title: Dusky Nightvow
description: Souls trapped within the night struggle among thorns, driven by resentment and hatred. From that hatred, seeds take root, scattering across the forest and blooming into vivid flowers atop white bones.

title: Gift of Renewal
description: Anyone who has taken part in the Tide Sending Ceremony comes to understand that life moves in cycles. Farewells are only the beginning of renewal, and longing endures forever.

title: New Journey Afar
description: She shoulders her pack and wanders old streets in the morning light. Gathering up the unease she felt when she first left the shelter, she hides a courage ready to see the world.

title: Holiday Waverider
description: The clear, deep waves kiss the shore, inviting the people on the beach to ride the crest. The ocean breeze praises the bravery of the wave-chasers—holidays are meant for chasing adventure and challenges. But first, make sure to stay safe in the water!

title: Dream's Voyage
description: The azure sea reflects the girl's silhouette, and a paper boat rocks gently atop the waves. With the course set and the flag pointing afar, she is ready to conquer the stars and seas of her own.

title: Clearsky Symphony
description: As the tide surges and the ocarina's low notes rise, she steps onto the stage with her former companions, taking the place reserved just for her, and offers her final song.

title: Sunlit Plush Bear
description: Whenever she takes out that yellowed sketch and brushes her fingers over the familiar little bear, she feels as though it is still waiting for a new design and for a warm embrace.
